entries.summary: For 1 minute, you add +{{charisma:modifier}} to attack rolls made with that weapon. The weapon also emits bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light 20 feet beyond that. entries.name: Channel Divinity: Snow Walker
entries.summary: Grant yourself the ability to walk on the surface of snow, ignoring any movement penalties it would normally cause. Ice supports your weight no matter how thin the ice is, and you can travel on it as if you’re wearing ice skates. You still leave tracks on snow and ice. It can move and use its reaction on its own, but the only action it takes on its turn is the Dodge action, unless you take a bonus action on your turn to command it to take one of the actions in its stat block or the Dash, Disengage, or Help action.

entries.name: Land's Stride
entries.summary: Moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. If you roll a 1, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table to create a magical effect. If that effect is a spell, it is too wild to be affected by your Metamagic, and if it normally requires concentration, it doesn’t require concentration in this case; the spell lasts for its full duration.

entries.name: Wild Shape
entries.summary: You magically assume the shape of a beast that you have seen before with a CR of 1 or lower. At the end of the duration you revert to your normal form unless you use this feature again and expend another 5 ingenuity points. You revert to your normal form after 1 minute or by using a bonus action on your turn. You automatically revert if you fall unconscious, drop to 0 hit points, or die.

entries.summary: Magic is an energy that suffuses the multiverse and that fuels both destruction and creation.

entries.name: Arcane Archer
entries.summary: An Arcane Archer studies a unique elven method of archery that weaves magic into attacks to produce supernatural effects.

entries.name: Arcane Origin
entries.summary: Your innate abilities come from a deep connection with the fabric of magic. You may have descended from a magical being, or you may have been touched by the raw essence of magic.

entries.name: Arcane Trickster
entries.summary: You enhance you fine-honed skills of stealth and agility with magic, learning tricks of enchantment and illusion.

entries.name: Arcane Trickster
entries.summary: Enhance Stealth with Arcane Spells Some Rogues enhance their fine-honed skills of stealth and agility with spells, learning magical tricks to aid them in their trade. Some Arcane Tricksters use their talents as pickpockets and burglars, while others are pranksters.

entries.name: Archfey Patron
entries.summary: Bargain with Whimsical Fey Your pact draws on the power of the Feywild. When you choose this subclass, you might make a deal with an archfey, such as the Prince of Frost; the Queen of Air and Darkness, ruler of the Gloaming Court; Titania of the Summer Court; or an ancient hag. Or you might call on a spectrum of Fey, weaving a web of favors and debts. Whoever they are, your patron is often inscrutable and whimsical.

entries.name: Archivist
entries.summary: A master of storing knowledge and creating artificial intelligences fueled by magic.

entries.name: Arena Royal
entries.summary: Pugilists in the Arena Royale fight club travel the world earning their keep as equal parts performer and gladiator.

entries.name: Armorer
entries.summary: An artificer who specializes as an Armorer modifies armor to function almost like a second skin. The armor is enhanced to hone the artificer’s magic, unleash potent attacks, and generate a formidable defense. The artificer bonds with this armor, becoming one with it even as they experiment with it and refine its magical capabilities.

entries.name: Armorer
entries.summary: An artificer who specializes as an Armorer modifies armor to function almost like a second skin. The armor is enhanced to hone the artificer’s magic, unleash potent attacks, and generate a formidable defense. The artificer bonds with this armor, becoming one with it even as they experiment with it and refine its magical capabilities.

entries.name: Artillerist
entries.publication: Eberron: Rising from the Last War
entries.summary: An Artillerist specializes in using magic to hurl energy, projectiles, and explosions on a battlefield.

entries.name: Artillerist
entries.summary: An Artillerist specializes in using magic to hurl energy, projectiles, and explosions on a battlefield. This destructive power is valued by armies in the wars on many different worlds.

entries.name: Artillerist
entries.summary: Specializes in using magic to create explosions, defensive positions, and magic-infused sidearms—that can be used on the battlefield.

entries.name: Artistry Domain
entries.summary: Gods of artistry—such as Denier, Milil, Branchala, and Apollo—promote creativity and imagination above all. These gods value all of the arts, including music, painting, sculpting, and other skilled crafts, though they often specialize in one craft above the others.

entries.name: Arts Domain
entries.publication: Reddit: Way of the Four Elements (Remastered)
entries.summary: The fundamental goodness of art in all its forms from paintings and crafts to poetry and song.

entries.name: Ashen Lineage
entries.summary: Somewhere in your bloodline, one of your ancestors made a pact with a powerful spirit of flame and predation known as the Ashen Wolf.

entries.name: Assassin (Revised)
entries.summary: You focus your training on the grim art of death. Those who adhere to this archetype are diverse: hired killers, spies, bounty hunters and more. Stealth, poison, and disguise help you eliminate your foes with deadly efficiency.

entries.name: Assassin
entries.summary: You focus your training on the grim art of death.

entries.name: Assassin
entries.summary: Practice the Grim Art of Death An Assassin’s training focuses on using stealth, poison, and disguise to eliminate foes with deadly efficiency. While some Rogues who follow this path are hired killers, spies, or bounty hunters, the capabilities of this subclass are equally useful for adventurers facing a variety of monstrous enemies.

entries.name: Awakened
entries.summary: An Awakened is a Psion who had their psionic power awakened within them by an encounter, event, or circumstance. Perhaps their powers were latent or perhaps their destiny had been that of a normal creature until powers were suddenly thrust on them.

entries.name: Battle Master
entries.summary: Those who emulate the archetypal Battle Master employ martial techniques passed down through generations.

entries.name: Battle Master
entries.summary: Master Sophisticated Battle Maneuvers Battle Masters are students of the art of battle, learning martial techniques passed down through generations. The most accomplished Battle Masters are well-rounded figures who combine their carefully honed combat skills with academic study in the fields of history, theory, and the arts.

entries.name: Battle Smith
entries.publication: Eberron: Rising from the Last War
entries.summary: Armies require protection, and someone has to put things back together if defenses fail.

entries.name: Battle Smith
entries.summary: Armies require protection, and someone has to put things back together if defenses fail. A combination of protector and medic, a Battle Smith is an expert at defending others and repairing both materiel and personnel.

entries.name: Battle Smith
entries.summary: An expert at defending others and repairing both material and personnel.

entries.name: Battlemage
entries.summary: Battlemages wear heavy armor and stride onto the battlefield with little worry for potential dangers. They, more than other swordmages, delve deep enough into the workings of magics to learn the same sorts of spells that wizards do. With this knowledge they wield their spells in flashy and destructive ways, while protecting their allies from harm.

entries.name: Beast & Briar
entries.summary: A violent encounter with a wild beast or the sting of poisonous nettles nearly laid you low. When you survived, you discovered your experience had changed you. Not only were you aware of the inconstant boundary between life and death, you also found you had a connection to the natural world.

entries.name: Beast Master
entries.summary: The Beast Master archetype embodies a friendship between the civilized races and the beasts of the world.

entries.name: Beast Master
entries.summary: Bond with a Primal Beast A Beast Master forms a mystical bond with a special animal, drawing on primal magic and a deep connection to the natural world.

entries.name: Beguiler
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: The tradition blends enchantment and illusion magic, rather than specializing in either of those schools.

entries.name: Black Flame Zealot
entries.summary: You use stealth, divine magic, and their fanatical zeal to further the interests of the Lord of Flames.

entries.name: Blackthorn Lineage
entries.summary: Somewhere in your lineage, an ancestor entered and made a pact with the Blackthorn Grove, replacing their heart with one crafted from the essence of the Grove itself.

entries.name: Bladesinging
entries.summary: Bladesingers are elves who bravely defend their people and lands.

entries.name: Bladesinging
entries.summary: You master a tradition of wizardry that incorporates swordplay and dance.

entries.name: Blizzard’s Heart
entries.summary: Only the hardiest of folk can survive the near constant wintry weather that besets the Northlands.

entries.name: Blood Domain
entries.summary: Originally developed in Wildemount by the Claret Orders, the Blood domain centers around the understanding of the natural life force within one’s own physical body.

entries.name: Blood Knight
entries.summary: The archetypal Blood Knight employs their own flesh and blood in the slaughter of their enemies. To a Blood Knight, battle is everything.

entries.name: Bloodhound Bruisers
entries.summary: Pugilists in the Bloodhound Bruisers fight club are notorious for looking for trouble and finding it every time.

entries.name: Bloody Blade
entries.summary: You were nearly done in by an attack at the hands of another humanoid. Whether it was a trusted friend, a stranger, or a hired assassin, the experience branded you with a interest in and capacity to inflict physical violence upon others. Spiritualists of this threshold sometimes see themselves as angels of death, saddled with the responsibility of judging who lives and who dies.

entries.name: Brewmeister
entries.summary: Where most would see only the danger or the fun in the world’s most common vice, the Brewmeister sees potential.

entries.name: Brute
entries.summary: Brutes are simple warriors who rely on mighty attacks and their own durability to overcome their enemies.

entries.name: Burghal Explorer
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: Burghal Explorers are at home in tight places, making their living as urban bounty hunters or guiding magical search crews through dangerous ruins. Dark slums and ruined cities, choked with thirsty weeds and decorated with crumbling remnants of once-thriving communities, become gathering points for desperate innocents—and for sneak-thieves and bandits who prey on the helpless.

entries.name: Cavalier
entries.summary: The archetypal Cavalier excels at mounted combat.

entries.name: Cavern Domain
entries.summary: Clerics with the cavern domain may seek it as a path to protecting miners and others who dwell in the dark.

entries.name: Celestial Patron
entries.summary: Call on the Power of the Heavens Your pact draws on the Upper Planes, the realms of everlasting bliss. You might enter an agreement with an empyrean, a couatl, a sphinx, a unicorn, or another heavenly entity. Or you might call on numerous such beings as you pursue goals aligned with theirs. Your pact allows you to experience a hint of the holy light that illuminates the multiverse.

entries.name: Champion
entries.summary: The archetypal Champion focuses on the development of raw physical power honed to deadly perfection.

entries.name: Champion
entries.summary: Pursue Physical Excellence in Combat A Champion focuses on the development of martial prowess in a relentless pursuit of victory. Champions combine rigorous training with physical excellence to deal devastating blows, withstand peril, and garner glory. Whether in athletic contests or bloody battle, Champions strive for the crown of the victor.

entries.name: Chaotician
entries.summary: Chaoticians unravel some of the fundamental workings of existence.

entries.name: Chieftain’s Presence
entries.summary: A chieftain is Warlord that rules by the sheer force of their personality, marked by their booming voice and fearless attitude, it is easy to believe that your band is infallible while your chieftain stands.

entries.name: Chronurgy Magic
entries.summary: Focusing on the manipulation of time, those who follow the Chronurgy tradition learn to alter the pace of reality to their liking. Using the ramping of anticipatory dunamis energy, these mages can bend the flow of time as adroitly as a skilled musician plays an instrument, lending themselves and their allies an advantage in the blink of an eye.

entries.name: Circle of Blight
entries.summary: The Circle of Blight is made up of devotees of Talona and the Rotting Man. Feared and reviled throughout the Great Dale, they revel in decay. Their plagues have transformed the Dunwood into a nightmarish swamp, and they seek to infect the healthy forests and tilled lands nearby.

entries.name: Circle of Constellations
entries.publication: All the Lights in the Sky are Stars
entries.summary: Druids who are members of the Circle of Constellations live nocturnally. On star-speckled nights, when the skies are clear, druids of the circle tell tales of shapes in the stars, of the beasts that dance across the velvety sky, and of the magic woven by the twinkling specks of light that hang above.

entries.name: Circle of Flames
entries.summary: Druids of the Circle of Flames recognize fire’s integral role in the natural world—they see it not only as a force of destruction, but as a force of rebirth, and ultimately of life.

entries.name: Circle of Gloaming
entries.summary: You embrace the decay and destruction exemplified in this region, using the latent energy of Mabar to twist foul rodents and insects to your will.

entries.name: Circle of Leth
entries.summary: You call on nature’s divine essence to transform into plant creatures.

entries.name: Circle of Sacrifice
entries.summary: Druids of the Circle of Sacrifice believe that nature connects one to the entire universe, including the stars and the astral void between planes. They know that immutable laws have been set down by the great powers of the universe and that sacrifices must be made to these powers in order to keep the balance.

entries.name: Circle of Seasons
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: Druids of the Circle of Seasons learn early in their trials that all things are transient.

entries.name: Circle of Spores
entries.summary: Druids of the Circle of Spores find beauty in decay.

entries.name: Circle of Spores
entries.summary: These druids believe that life and death are parts of a grand cycle, with one leading to the other and then back again. Death isn’t the end of life, but instead a change of state that sees life shift into a new form.

entries.name: Circle of Spores
entries.summary: Druids of the Circle of Spores find beauty in decay. They see within mold and other fungi the ability to transform lifeless material into abundant, albeit somewhat strange, life. These druids believe that life and death are portions of a grand cycle, with one leading to the other and then back again.

entries.name: Circle of Stars
entries.summary: The Circle of Stars allows druids to draw on the power of starlight. These druids have tracked heavenly patterns since time immemorial, discovering secrets hidden amid the constellations.

entries.name: Circle of Stone
entries.summary: Druids who are members of the Circle of Stone have a special connection with the very bones of the world and commune with the elemental spirits that inhabit mountains, hills, caves, and tunnels. These druids resist change and seek to preserve things as they are. They consider the ancient stone circles that can be found throughout the Realms to be sacred places.

entries.name: Circle of the Claw
entries.summary: The Circle of the Claw has a focus on the use of beast form, and stronger forms of it instead of spells. It can stay in beast form for a long time, but has severe drawbacks when they fall out of it in order to discourage abusing the hit point generation it can provide.

entries.name: Circle of the Dreams
entries.summary: Druids who are members of the Circle of Dreams hail from regions that have strong ties to the Feywild and its dreamlike realms. The druids’ guardianship of the natural world makes for a natural alliance between them and good-aligned fey.

entries.name: Circle of the Land
entries.summary: The Circle of the Land is made up of mystics and sages who safeguard ancient knowledge and rites through a vast oral tradition.

entries.name: Circle of the Land
entries.summary: Celebrate Connection to the Natural World The Circle of the Land comprises mystics and sages who safeguard ancient knowledge and rites. These Druids meet within sacred circles of trees or standing stones to whisper primal secrets in Druidic. The circle’s wisest members preside as the chief priests of their communities.

entries.name: Circle of the Moon
entries.summary: Druids of the Circle of the Moon are fierce guardians of the wilds.

entries.name: Circle of the Moon
entries.summary: Adopt Animal Forms to Guard the Wilds Druids of the Circle of the Moon draw on lunar magic to transform themselves. Their order gathers under the moon to share news and perform rituals.

entries.name: Circle Of The Primeval
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: The Circle of the Primeval teaches that, though the land may change over time, it never truly forgets. By tapping into the timeworn memory of the earth, these druids summon and bond with the spirit of a primeval behemoth—a hulking creature that once ruled the ancient world alongside the giants.

entries.name: Circle of the Sea
entries.summary: Become One with Tides and Storms Druids of the Circle of the Sea draw on the tempestuous forces of oceans and storms. Some view themselves as embodiments of nature’s wrath, seeking vengeance against those who despoil nature.

entries.name: Circle of the Shepherd
entries.summary: Druids of the Circle of the Shepherd commune with the spirits of nature, especially the spirits of beasts and the fey, and call to those spirits for aid. These druids recognize that all living things play a role in the natural world, yet they focus on protecting animals and fey creatures that have difficulty defending themselves.

entries.name: Circle of The Spiritlords
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: Ages ago, nature priests with a greater connection to the spirit realm believed the world itself to be formed from a group of elemental and primordial spirits, each specifically charged to harness one of the major elements of creation.

entries.name: Circle of the Stars
entries.summary: Harness Secrets Hidden in Constellations The Circle of the Stars has tracked heavenly patterns since time immemorial, discovering secrets hidden amid the constellations. By understanding these secrets, the Druids of this circle seek to harness the powers of the cosmos.

entries.name: Circle of the Stars
entries.summary: An ancient lineage, the Circle of Stars allows druids to draw on the power of starlight. These druids have tracked heavenly patterns since time immemorial, discovering secrets hidden amid the constellations.

entries.name: Circle of The Strange Beasts
entries.publication: Reddit: Way of the Four Elements (Remastered)
entries.summary: From time to time, gigantic creatures appear in the realm of men. Awakened from their slumber when nature's balance is endangered or created by sinister experiments mixing magic and science, those immense beasts are considered by many folks to be the incarnation of Nature itself, expressing it's wrath.

entries.name: Circle of the Sun
entries.summary: Druids connected with the Circle of the Sun hail from regions that have strong ties to the celestial planes, like Mount Celestia or Elysium. These druids form connections with celestial spirits and the radiant energy of the upper planes, granting them exceptional magical capabilities, and the ability to summon celestial spirits to aid them.

entries.name: Circle of Twilight
entries.summary: The Circle of Twilight is an ancient sect of druids, long estranged from other druidic circles due to their differing outlooks on the natural world. The Circle of Twilight believes that the spirits of nature need regular sacrifices of beasts, natural and unnatural, and even the occasional human sacrifice.

entries.name: Circle of Twilight
entries.summary: The Circle of Twilight seeks to exterminate undead creatures and preserve the natural cycle of life and death that rules over the cosmos.

entries.name: Circle of Wildfire
entries.summary: Druids within the Circle of Wildfire understand that destruction is sometimes the precursor of creation, such as when a forest fire promotes later growth. These druids bond with a primal spirit that harbors both destructive and creative power, allowing the druids to create controlled flames that burn away one thing but give life to another.

entries.name: Circle of Wildfire
entries.summary: Druids who are members of the Circle of Wildfire understand the necessity of destruction, such as how a forest fire promotes growth.

entries.name: Cirle of Stone
entries.summary: You have a special connection with the very bones of the world and commune with the elemental spirits that inhabit mountains, hills, caves, and tunnels.

entries.name: City Domain
entries.summary: The City domain is concerned with the citizenry, commerce, traffic, and even architecture of modern civilization.

entries.name: Clockwork Domain
entries.summary: Rava, the Goddess of Gear, has blessed her followers with unusual powers, but she is not the only being in the multiverse that can grant the clockwork domain.

entries.name: Clockwork Sorcery
entries.summary: Channel Cosmic Forces of Order The cosmic force of order has suffused you with magic. That power arises from Mechanus or a realm like it—a plane of existence shaped entirely by clockwork efficiency.

entries.name: Clockwork Soul
entries.summary: The cosmic force of order has suffused you with magic. That power arises from Mechanus or a realm like it—a plane of existence shaped entirely by clockwork efficiency. You, or someone from your lineage, might have become entangled in the machinations of the modrons, the orderly beings who inhabit Mechanus.

entries.name: Clockwork Soul
entries.summary: A plane of utmost order, Mechanus is a realm overseen by a godlike entity called Primus, whose actions are inscrutable and calculations, vast. You, or someone from your lineage, might have become entangled in one of the machinations of the leader of the modrons.

entries.name: Coinmonger
entries.summary: Channeling planar magic into mundane coins to alter reality around them.

entries.name: College of Benevolence
entries.summary: Bards of the College of Benevolence honed their craft in the upper planes, or at least through the tutelage of a creature native to the upper planes. These bards often learn their magic from celestial creatures, such as lesser angels, couatls, ki-rin, and unicorns.

entries.name: College of Creation
entries.summary: Bards believe the cosmos is a work of art—the creation of the first dragons and gods. That creative work included harmonies that continue to resound through existence today, a power known as the Song of Creation.

entries.name: College of Creation
entries.summary: Bards believe the multiverse was given existence through word and sound, esoteric harmonies that continue to resound through existence: the Song of Creation. The bards of this college draw on this ancient power through performances of dance, music, or song to bring into being what they need most.

entries.name: College of Dance
entries.summary: Move in Harmony with the Cosmos Bards of the College of Dance know that the Words of Creation can’t be contained within speech or song; the words are uttered by the movements of celestial bodies and flow through the motions of the smallest creatures. These Bards practice a way of being in harmony with the whirling cosmos that emphasizes agility, speed, and grace.

entries.name: College of Discord
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: Bards of the College of Discord yearn to take the performances to the next level. While some artists feel the need to prepare or learn progressions within a harmonic framework, the extemporaneous nature of the bard’s study encourages inventing variations in their musical repertoire mid performance.

entries.name: College of Eloquence
entries.summary: Adherents of the College of Eloquence master the art of oratory. Persuasion is regarded as a high art, and a well-reasoned, well-spoken argument often proves more persuasive than facts. These bards wield a blend of logic and theatrical wordplay, winning over skeptics and detractors with logical arguments and plucking at heartstrings to appeal to the emotions of audiences.

entries.name: College of Eloquence
entries.summary: Adherents of the College of Eloquence master the art of oratory. These bards wield a blend of logic and theatrical wordplay, winning over skeptics and detractors with logical arguments and plucking at heartstrings to appeal to the emotions of audiences.

entries.name: College of Eloquence
entries.summary: Adherents of the College of Eloquence master the art of oratory.

entries.name: College of Entropy
entries.summary: Itinerate gamblers and daring thrill seekers whose actions are supremely unpredictable.

entries.name: College of Epic Poetry
entries.summary: Bards who study the College of Epic Poetry are devoted to the creation of a singular masterpiece in the tradition of the epic poets. All the greatest stories in history were originally captured and recreated for audiences as masterful works of poetry.

entries.name: College of Glamour
entries.summary: Weave Beguiling Fey Magic The College of Glamour traces its origins to the beguiling magic of the Feywild. Bards who study this magic weave threads of beauty and terror into their songs and stories, and the mightiest among them can cloak themselves in otherworldly majesty.

entries.name: College of Glamour
entries.summary: The College of Glamour is the home of bards who mastered their craft in the vibrant realm of the Feywild or under the tutelage Of someone who dwelled there. Tutored by satyrs, eladrin, and other fey, these bards learn to use their magic to delight and captivate others.

entries.name: College of Graysong
entries.summary: Those of the college of the Graysong weave memories and souls to harness the power of this terrible sound.

entries.name: College of Harbingers
entries.summary: Bards of the College of Harbingers are disciples of the Storm Lord.

entries.name: College of Keys
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: Bards of the College of Keys believe that performance can manipulate anything, be it person, magic, or machine. Their preternatural charm allows these daring performers to delve into dungeons seething with traps, assured that they can use their words and song to protect themselves and allies. These bards often become spies and infiltrators, since no lock can stand up to their charms.

entries.name: College of Lore
entries.summary: Bards of the College of Lore know something about most things, collecting bits of knowledge from sources as diverse as scholarly tomes and peasant tales.

entries.name: College of Lore
entries.summary: Plumb the Depths of Magical Knowledge Bards of the College of Lore collect spells and secrets from diverse sources, such as scholarly tomes, mystical rites, and peasant tales. The college’s members gather in libraries and universities to share their lore with one another.

entries.name: College of Mourning
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: Bards of the College of Mourning specialize in easing the transition from life to death. While most bards derive their artistic catalogue from celebrating the lives of the valiant, mourning bards create a gateway for dead knights, faithful priests, and wise viziers who dedicated their lives in service, to accomplish any lingering obligations of the Material Plane.

entries.name: College of Portraiture
entries.summary: Bards of the College of Portraiture are artisans first and foremost.

entries.name: College of Satire
entries.summary: Jesters use lowbrow stories, daring acrobatics, and cutting jokes to entertain audiences, ranging from the crowds in a rundown dockside pub to the nobles of a king’s royal court.

entries.name: College of Spirits
entries.summary: Stories of the past are powerful; they hold lessons of history, philosophy, and magic. Bards of the College of Spirits seek the stories of those from beyond the material plane. Using gaming sets, they reach out to hear their stories, but the bards have no control over what story they find.

entries.name: College of Spirits
entries.summary: Bards of the College of Spirits seek tales with inherent power—be they legends, histories, or fictions—and bring their subjects to life. Using occult trappings, these bards conjure spiritual embodiments of powerful forces to change the world once more. Such spirits are capricious, though, and what a bard summons isn’t always entirely under their control.

entries.name: College of Superstars
entries.publication: All the Lights in the Sky are Stars
entries.summary: The College of Superstars is home to the most ambitious performers, artists, singers, and dancers. Bards of this college seek to dazzle audiences with their brilliance and talent, competing endlessly with one another to become the world’s brightest star.

entries.name: College of Swords
entries.summary: Bards of the College of Swords are called blades, and they entertain through daring feats of weapon prowess. Blades perform stunts such as sword swallowing, knife throwing and juggling, and mock combats.

entries.name: College of the Maestro
entries.summary: Wandering bards have mastered the art of creating music to shape and manipulate the thoughts and hearts of the world through song, words, and instrument.

entries.name: College of the Shadowfell
entries.summary: Bards of the College of the Shadowfell specialize in the study of that realm, gleaming great knowledge of shadow magic in the process. These bards are few in number and their study is far harder than most, for knowledge of the Shadowfell is hard to come by.

entries.name: College of Valor
entries.summary: Bards of the College of Valor are daring skalds whose tales keep alive the memory of the great heroes of the past, and thereby inspire a new generation of heroes.

entries.name: College of Valor
entries.summary: Sing the Deeds of Ancient Heroes Bards of the College of Valor are daring storytellers whose tales preserve the memory of the great heroes of the past. These Bards sing the deeds of the mighty in vaulted halls or to crowds gathered around great bonfires.

entries.name: College of Whispers
entries.summary: Most folk are happy to welcome a bard into their midst. Bards of the College of Whispers use this to their advantage. They appear to be like other bards, sharing news, singing songs, and telling tales to the audiences they gather.

entries.name: Combat Mastery
entries.summary: The Combat Mastery archetype specializes in combat techniques of raw physical power honed to deadly perfection. Those who model themselves on this archetype combine rigorous training with physical excellence to deal devastating blows in combat.

entries.name: Commander’s Presence
entries.summary: A Commander on the field can be many things - a trusted Sergeant, a weary Veteran, or merely a man with an uncommon degree of common sense and a particularly keen eye for how to win a fight.

entries.name: Courage Domain
entries.summary: The Courage domain focuses on personal heroics, and acts of valor and self-sacrifice. While the Courage domain bears many similarities to the War domain, it is more individualistic and isn’t directly connected to war.

entries.name: Crimson Couturier
entries.summary: Your tapestry manifests as an eye of living thread and arcane intelligence, bound to your infusion. It is sentient and can speak with you, though it is merely a reflection of your own subconscious knowledge. You pour your own blood into this tapestry as you fight, and it grants you speed, strength, and endless determination. Fight as one, and find your way.

entries.name: Death Domain
entries.summary: The Death domain is concerned with the forces that cause death, as well as the negative energy that gives rise to undead creatures.

entries.name: Deathtouched
entries.summary: Your innate magic comes from a past encounter with death. Most often, this origin is traced back to surviving an attack from an undead, such as a vampire’s bite, a ghost’s possession, or a specter’s life drain. Or, it could have originated from an imperfect revival or near-death experience. Regardless of the way you attained this dark magic, it now dictates your life and greatly augments your power.

entries.name: Delver
entries.summary: In the darkest tombs, the most cursed catacombs, and the deepest of dungeons, Delvers are right at home. Skilled navigators and experts at finding and procuring artifacts, they have a nose for trouble, and the right set of skills and know how to get out of any scrape.

entries.name: Demigod
entries.summary: Your magic springs from the divine blood that flows through your veins.

entries.name: Devout
entries.summary: An archetypical Devout bears a distinct resemblance to paladins and clerics, particularly in the way they present themselves. While they lack the divine magic offered by these classes, their divine fervor and unshakeable devotion to their gods are far from lacking.

entries.name: Discordant
entries.summary: You have dedicated your martial focus to the creation of dissonance.

entries.name: Divine Hand
entries.summary: As a Divine Hand, you focus your training on the arts of death and execution. However, unlike an assassin you do not employ yourself in the service of mortals. You have a higher calling, and have devoted yourself into the service of a deity.

entries.name: Divine Herald
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: Your strict upbringing has made you an unwavering and swift agent of divine retribution.

entries.name: Divine Soul
entries.summary: Sometimes the spark of magic that fuels a sorcerer comes from a divine source that glimmers within the soul.

entries.name: Diviner
entries.summary: Learn the Secrets of the Multiverse The counsel of a Diviner is sought by those who want a clearer understanding of the past, present, and future. As a Diviner, you strive to part the veils of space, time, and consciousness. You work to master spells of discernment, remote viewing, supernatural knowledge, and foresight.

entries.name: Dog And Hound
entries.summary: You’ve never had a friend you could rely on that walked on two legs. Lucky for you, you’ve got the best four-legged friend a body could ask for.

entries.name: Draconic Bloodline
entries.summary: Your innate magic comes from draconic magic that was mingled with your blood or that of your ancestors.

entries.name: Draconic Sorcery
entries.summary: Breathe the Magic of Dragons Your innate magic comes from the gift of a dragon. Perhaps an ancient dragon facing death bequeathed some of its magical power to you or your ancestor. You might have absorbed magic from a site infused with dragons’ power. Or perhaps you handled a treasure taken from a dragon’s hoard that was steeped in draconic power. Or you might have a dragon for an ancestor.

entries.name: Dragon Mage
entries.summary: Dragon magi manifest their magic in many styles as diverse as the draconic species and the types of magic that populate the worlds.

entries.name: Dragoon
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: An elite combatant, selected from the ranks of standard cavalry soldiers for their prowess in battle and exceptional mounted dexterity.

entries.name: Drakewarden
entries.summary: Your connection to the natural world takes the form of a draconic spirit, which can manifest in physical form as a drake. As your powers grow, your drake grows as well, blossoming from a small four-legged companion to a majestic winged creature large and strong enough for you to ride.

entries.name: Drakewarden
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: Drakewardens are rangers who use their magical connection with nature to form an enduring bond with a minor dragon, a drake. This bond allows the ranger to summon the drake to their side and to share in the awe-inspiring power wielded by dragons.

entries.name: Dream Cartography
entries.summary: You’ve chosen to begin to map your own dreams by pursuing this tradition, seeking insight into the lands beyond the veil of sleep.

entries.name: Echo Knight
entries.summary: A mysterious and feared frontline warrior of the Kryn Dynasty, the Echo Knight has mastered the art of using dunamis to summon the fading shades of unrealized timelines to aid them in battle. Surrounded by echoes of their own might, they charge into the fray as a cycling swarm of shadows and strikes.

entries.name: Eldritch Archer
entries.summary: Eldritch Archers specialize in ranged weaponry, weaving magic into their shots and uing their weapons to extend the lethal range of their spells.

entries.name: Eldritch Knight
entries.summary: The archetypal Eldritch Knight combines the martial mastery common to all fighters with a careful study of magic.

entries.name: Eldritch Knight
entries.summary: Support Combat Skills with Arcane Magic Eldritch Knights combine the martial mastery common to all Fighters with a careful study of magic. Their spells both complement and extend their combat skills, providing additional protection to shore up their armor and also allowing them to engage many foes at once with explosive magic.

entries.name: Elemental Domain
entries.summary: Clerics of the Elemental domain are unique among their peers, as they often worship a group of deities, rather than focusing their prayers in the worship of only one god. This domain includes gods of fire, such as Kossuth or Sirrion, gods of water and oceans, such as Umberlee or Poseidon, gods of the earth, including Ulaa and Skadi, gods of air and storms, including Talos and Zeus, and other such deities.

entries.name: Elemental Essence
entries.summary: Your innate magic arises from elemental power suffused into your being.

entries.name: Elemental Mind
entries.summary: An Elemental Mind Psion carries a psionic link to a primal power, some have a link to a particular element while others find all elements within their mind, raging an eternal war. Often viewed as dangerous, they can erupt with power if not careful, but in time can gain great mastery over the elements.

entries.name: Elementalism
entries.summary: You focus your arcane studies on the power inherent to one of the Elemental Planes.

entries.name: Eltab, Lord of the Hidden Layer
entries.summary: You have made a pact with the Demon Lord Eltab.

add.value: Eltab, Lord of the Hidden Layer

entries.name: Ember Knight
entries.summary: An ember knight employs martial techniques combined with potent fire magic. While ember knights are often mistaken for the more common eldritch knights at first glance, the source of an ember knight’s magic comes from within, rather than from the study of magic.

entries.name: Entropy Domain
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: Heretics preach of a void at the center of the universe that dying gods created to devour the Weave.

entries.name: Esoteric Plasmology
entries.summary: It is common for one to ask a disciple of this tradition: “Are you a wizard that casts ooze-related spells, or an ooze that is a wizard?” The truth is, both are correct. Esoteric plasmology has long ties to the Gelatinous Convocation, which wanders between worlds spreading happy, cheerful slimes to all corners of the multiverse.

entries.name: Evasive Mastery
entries.summary: The Evasive Mastery archetype specializes in agile movements to maneuver around the battle field like the wind. Those who model themselves on this archetype are nimble and have excelling awareness of their surroundings.

entries.name: Evoker
entries.summary: Create Explosive Elemental Effects Your studies focus on magic that creates powerful elemental effects such as bitter cold, searing flame, rolling thunder, crackling lightning, and burning acid. Some Evokers find employment in military forces, serving as artillery to blast armies from afar. Others use their power to protect others, while some seek their own gain.

entries.name: Farseer
entries.summary: Your magic comes from a god of prophecy and prognostication who imbued a sliver of its power in your ancestry.

entries.name: Fate Domain
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: Clerics who draw power from the forces of fate sometimes receive visions directly from their deity and receive fleeting omens of the future.

entries.name: Fey Magic
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: Your innate magic comes from fey magic that was mingled with your blood or that of your ancestors.

entries.name: Fey Wanderer
entries.summary: Wield Fey Mirth and Fury A fey mystique surrounds you, thanks to the boon of an archfey or a location in the Feywild that transformed you. However you gained fey magic, you are now a Fey Wanderer. Your joyful laughter brightens the hearts of the downtrodden, and your martial prowess strikes terror in your foes, for great is the mirth of the fey and dreadful is their fury.

entries.name: Fey Wanderer
entries.summary: A fey mystique surrounds you, thanks to the boon of an archfey, the shining fruit you ate from a talking tree, the magic spring you swam in, or some other auspicious event. However you acquired your fey magic, you are now a Fey Wanderer, a ranger who represents both the mortal and the fey realms.

entries.name: Fey Wanderer
entries.summary: As a Fey Wanderer, you guard the border between the Feywild and the Material Plane, guiding the lost out of the Feywild and preventing dangerous fey from damaging the Material Plane.

entries.name: Fiend Patron
entries.summary: Make a Deal with the Lower Planes Your pact draws on the Lower Planes, the realms of perdition. You might forge a bargain with a demon lord such as Demogorgon or Orcus; an archdevil such as Asmodeus; or a pit fiend, balor, yugoloth, or night hag that is especially mighty.

entries.name: Fiend Slayer
entries.summary: A barbarian that burns with a righteous fury and a primal drive to slay fiends.

entries.name: Fire Binder
entries.summary: Masters of binding fire elementals to weapons, vehicles, and even themselves.

entries.name: Firescrapper
entries.summary: As the name implies, firescrappers specialize in the use of pyromantic magic. They are quite unlike wizardly pyromancers, however, as they use this magic to become powerful front-line fighters rather than back-line mages.

entries.name: Flametouched
entries.summary: Your magic stems from the primordial energy of elemental fire. Many sorcerers with this power can trace their ancestry to the creatures of the Plane of Elemental fire, particularly the Efreeti.

entries.name: Forest Soul
entries.summary: You are one with the trees.

entries.name: Forge Domain
entries.summary: The gods of the forge are patrons of artisans who work with metal, from a humble blacksmith who keeps a village in horseshoes and plow blades to the mighty elf artisan whose diamond-tipped arrows of mithral have felled demon lords.

entries.name: Geomancy
entries.summary: Geomancy teaches the art of becoming like a ley line and bonding with the great flow of power.

entries.name: Ghost in the Machine
entries.summary: You have made a pact with a fiend from the lower planes of existence.

entries.name: Giant Soul
entries.summary: Your power comes from the gifts imparted by the giants.

entries.name: Gloom Stalker
entries.summary: Draw on Shadow Magic to Fight Your Foes Gloom Stalkers are at home in the darkest places, wielding magic drawn from the Shadowfell to combat enemies that lurk in darkness.

entries.name: Gloom Stalker
entries.summary: Gloom Stalkers are at home in the darkest places: deep under the earth, in gloomy alleyways, in primeval forests, and wherever else the light dims.

entries.name: Grave Domain
entries.summary: Gods of the grave watch over the line between life and death. To these deities, death and the afterlife are a foundational part of the multiverse. To desecrate the peace of the dead is an abomination.

entries.name: Graverobber
entries.summary: Your spirit is filled with both the eerie power of darkness and the flowing force of life, granting you the ability to touch the souls of others directly.

entries.name: Graviturgy Magic
entries.summary: Understanding and mastering the forces that draw bodies of matter together or drive them apart, the students of te Graviturgy arcane tradition learn to further bend and manipulate the violent energy of gravity to their benefit, and the terrible detriment of their enemies.

entries.name: Great Old One Patron
entries.summary: Unearth Forbidden Lore of Ineffable Beings When you choose this subclass, you might bind yourself to an unspeakable being from the Far Realm or an elder god—a being such as Tharizdun, the Chained God; Zargon, the Returner; Hadar, the Dark Hunger; or Great Cthulhu.

entries.name: Grove Knight
entries.summary: The grove knight is interested in protecting the woods at all costs.

entries.name: Gunslinger
entries.summary: Most warriors and combat specialists spend their years perfecting the classic arts of swordplay, archery, or polearm tactics. Whether duelist or infantry, martial weapons were seemingly perfected long ago, and the true challenge is to master them.

entries.name: Gunsmith
entries.summary: A master of engineering, you forge a firearm powered by a combination of science and magic.

entries.name: Hand of Dread
entries.summary: In your darkest hour you pleaded for the strength to take what you wanted from the world and a dread power took notice.

entries.name: Hash Slinger
entries.summary: The archetypal Hash Slinger believes more in the scientific aspect of food than in the art of it.

entries.name: Hell Guide
entries.summary: A planar ranger that perceives the Nine Hells as another environment to be mastered.

entries.name: Hellfire Sorcerer
entries.summary: A sorcerer whose blood surges with the necrotic flames of hell.

entries.name: Herculean Path
entries.summary: Some individuals are born with seemingly impossible strength.

entries.name: Heroic Ancestry
entries.summary: Your innate magic comes from your connection to an ancient hero—an ancestor of yours that defeated mighty foes and reached the peak of physical ability. In the years beyond their death, your ancestor’s deeds have been immortalized by history, and their bloodline has been blessed by the gods.

entries.name: Hoplite
entries.summary: The rank-and-file warriors of large cities are sometimes trained to fight in large armies of identically-outfitted soldiers called hoplites. Hoplites fight behind heavy shields, which have notches to accommodate the use of spears and javelins.

entries.name: Horizon Walker
entries.summary: Horizon Walkers guard the world against threats that originate from other planes or that seek to ravage the mortal realm with otherworldly magic.

entries.name: Hound of the Huntsman
entries.summary: The sheer power of the Wild Huntsman’s cold intent tore the beast open and infused you with its spirit.

entries.name: Hunt Domain
entries.summary: The gods of the hunt value skill above all else—whether it be skill as a tracker of cunning prey, a slayer of mighty beasts, or a marksman of unparalleled accuracy—it does not matter.

entries.name: Hunter
entries.summary: Emulating the Hunter archetype means accepting your place as a bulwark between civilization and the terrors of the wilderness.

entries.name: Hunter
entries.summary: Protect Nature and People from Destruction You stalk prey in the wilds and elsewhere, using your abilities as a Hunter to protect nature and people everywhere from forces that would destroy them.

entries.name: Illusionist
entries.summary: Weave Subtle Spells of Deception You specialize in magic that dazzles the senses and tricks the mind, and the illusions you craft make the impossible seem real.

entries.name: Inquisitive
entries.summary: Roots out secrets, akin to a masterful detective.

entries.name: Justice Domain
entries.summary: Gods of justice and law—including Tyr, Pholtus, Trithereon, Aureon, Anubis, and Forseti—exemplify order and lawfulness, and the pursuit of just reparations and retributions. Some of these gods are ruthless in their pursuit of justice, and are quick to enact retribution when crimes are committed, while others are more forgiving and open to punishments other than death.

entries.name: Keeper
entries.summary: An eager doctor's assistant stays late after a failed surgery to stitch the cadaver closed, and prepare it for transport to the undertaker. But while he has the remains here to himself, he sees no harm in a little research.

entries.name: Knight
entries.summary: The Knight is a colossus on the battlefield who can shrug off attacks and protect allies from harm.

entries.name: Knowledge Domain
entries.summary: The gods of knowledge value learning and understanding above all.

entries.name: Lawbringer
entries.summary: Through this contract you gain great magic with which to order the world around you.

entries.name: Life Domain
entries.summary: The Life domain focuses on the vibrant positive energy— one of the fundamental forces of the universe—that sustains all life.

entries.name: Life Domain
entries.summary: Soothe the Hurts of the World The Life Domain focuses on the positive energy that helps sustain all life in the multiverse. Clerics who tap into this domain are masters of healing, using that life force to cure many hurts.

entries.name: Light Domain
entries.summary: Gods of light promote the ideals of rebirth and renewal, truth, vigilance, and beauty, often using the symbol of the sun.

entries.name: Light Domain
entries.summary: Bring Light to Banish Darkness The Light Domain emphasizes the divine power to bring about blazing fire and revelation. Clerics who wield this power are enlightened souls infused with radiance and the power of their deities' discerning vision, charged with chasing away lies and burning away darkness.

entries.name: Lightcaller
entries.summary: Rangers that walk the path of the Lightcaller draw their power from the positive plane, and use that power to defend the wildlands and hunt down the evils that dwell there. These rangers wield their radiant weapons like extensions of their body, and learn combat techniques that make them highly varied in their combat styles.

entries.name: Lightslinger
entries.summary: A Lightslinger learns how to harness magical, radiant energy and put it to use in their weaponry. These artificers create complex machines that channel and focus light, turning that energy into powerful beams that can sear their foes.

entries.name: Lore Mastery
entries.summary: Lore Mastery is an arcane tradition fixated on understanding the underlying mechnanics of magic.

entries.name: Lore of the Hero
entries.summary: Factotums who delve into Lore of the Hero take on a slightly martial bent.

entries.name: Lore of the Theurge
entries.summary: Factotums who delve into Lore of the Theurge seek to further develop their spellcasting and magical abilities.

entries.name: Love Domain
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: Note:The Love Domain was included in an early version of Unearthed Arcana: Subclasses, Part 2. The subclass caused controversy within the community, so it was officially replaced with the Unity Domain in the final release of the document.

entries.name: Lunar Magic
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: On many worlds, the moon is a revered celestial body with magical properties. On Krynn, the gods of magic are associated with the world's three moons. On the world of Toril, the god Selûne uses the light of the moon to battle darkness.

entries.name: Lunar Sorcery
entries.publication: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen
entries.summary: On many worlds, the moon is a revered celestial body with magical properties. On Krynn, the gods of magic are associated with the world's three moons. On the world of Toril, the god Selûne uses the light of the moon to battle darkness.

entries.name: Mage Hunter
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: Mage hunters of today have shifted their focus from regulators to preservers.

entries.name: Mage of Lorehold
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: Mages of Lorehold are particularly concerned with the forces that underlie and drive history.

entries.name: Mage of Lorehold
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: Mages of Lorehold are particularly concerned with the forces that underlie and drive history.

entries.name: Mage of Lorehold
