entries.summary: Mages of Lorehold are particularly concerned with the forces that underlie and drive history.

entries.name: Mage of Prismari
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: Mages of Prismari use surges of elemental energy to express who they are and how they see the world.

entries.name: Mage of Prismari
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: Mages of Prismari use surges of elemental energy to express who they are and how they see the world.

entries.name: Mage of Prismari
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: Mages of Prismari use surges of elemental energy to express who they are and how they see the world.

entries.name: Mage of Quandrix
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: For those who become Mages of Quandrix, math and magic go hand-in-hand.

entries.name: Mage of Quandrix
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: For those who become Mages of Quandrix, math and magic go hand-in-hand.

entries.name: Mage of Silverquill
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: Mages of Silverquill hone the power of words.

entries.name: Mage of Silverquill
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: Mages of Silverquill hone the power of words.

entries.name: Mage of Silverquill
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: Mages of Silverquill hone the power of words.

entries.name: Mage of Witherbloom
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: Mages of Witherbloom draw their magic from the energy that endlessly flows from life to death, and back again.

entries.name: Mage of Witherbloom
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: Mages of Witherbloom draw their magic from the energy that endlessly flows from life to death, and back again.

entries.name: Mastermind
entries.summary: Your focus is on people and on the influence and secrets they have.

entries.name: Mess Sergeant
entries.summary: The Mess Sergeant believes in a stringent diet, complete control over what goes in and out of one’s body.

entries.name: Meteor Knight
entries.publication: All the Lights in the Sky are Stars
entries.summary: Fighters who fight like falling stones, Meteor Knights are uniquely specialized in utilizing blunt weaponry to their maximum effectiveness. Fighters of this school typically prefer maces, warhammers, and mauls, although some utilize staves and clubs to resounding effect.

entries.name: Monster Hunter
entries.summary: As an archetypal Monster Hunter, you are an expert at defeating supernatural threats.

entries.name: Monster Masher
entries.summary: Most cooks stumble upon the physical power of vitality, or perhaps they simply feel its power in their gut.

entries.name: Monster Slayer
entries.summary: You have dedicated yourself to hunting down creatures of the night and wielders of grim magic.

entries.name: Mortal Couturier
entries.summary: You are different from other weaveshapers. You view your threadblade as the ultimate accessory, so you seek to master every form it can take. You store your research in a floating, illusory tome that follows at your shoulder, holding your infinite array of threadblades within.

entries.name: Myth Breaker
entries.summary: Myth Breakers specialize in hunting down and dealing with the most dangerous of beasts.

entries.name: Nar Demonbinder
entries.summary: You use powerful conjuration magic to summon demons and bind them into service.

entries.name: Nature Domain
entries.summary: Gods of nature are as varied as the natural world itself, from inscrutable gods of the deep forests to friendly deities associated with particular springs and groves.

entries.name: Nentyar Hunter
entries.summary: You master a greater command of druidic and totemic powers.

entries.name: Nighstalker
entries.summary: The Nightstalker archetype emulates a unique form of shadow magic, used to create shadowy familiars to accompany you in battle.

entries.name: Night Domain
entries.summary: These clerics excel in both melee combat and spellcasting, always using the cover of darkness to their advantage in both their battles and their attempts at subterfuge.

entries.name: Nightmare
entries.publication: All the Lights in the Sky are Stars
entries.summary: Rogues of the Nightmare archetype excel at combat in the dark, inflicting terror into their foes. These combatants prefer to operate at night or in places that otherwise never see the light of day, and are feared by the common folk. Nightmare rogues often scout out their targets’ deepest fears, replicating them to great effect.

entries.name: Noble’s Presence
entries.summary: A Warlord with a Noble Presence is not inherently one that was born a Noble, though many are. A Noble Presence Warlord is one that serves to drive their retainers and companions onto greater heights through sheer charisma, a shining beacon of what they are fighting for standing beside them.

entries.name: Oath of Avarice
entries.summary: You’ve sworn to let nothing stand between you and the accumulation of wealth, as any whim that takes you can be accomplished with the prudent use of overwhelming financial might.

entries.name: Oath of Cinders
entries.summary: The Oath of Cinders was first taken in an age long past, not long after the time man first harnessed the power of fire. The paladins that take this oath are sometimes called pyre knights, red knights, or ashen knights, as their oath grants them command over the element of fire.

entries.name: Oath of Conquest
entries.summary: The Oath of Conquest calls to paladins who seek glory in battle and the subjugation of their enemies.

entries.name: Oath of Devotion
entries.summary: The Oath of Devotion binds a paladin to the loftiest ideals of justice, virtue, and order. Sometimes called cavaliers, white knights, or holy warriors, these paladins meet the ideal of the knight in shining armor, acting with honor in pursuit of justice and the greater good.

entries.name: Oath of Devotion
entries.summary: Uphold the Ideals of Justice and Order The Oath of Devotion binds Paladins to the ideals of justice and order. These Paladins meet the archetype of the knight in shining armor. They hold themselves to the highest standards of conduct, and some—for better or worse—hold the rest of the world to the same standards.

entries.name: Oath of Glory
entries.summary: Paladins who take the Oath of Glory believe they and their companions are destined to achieve glory through deeds of heroism. They train diligently and encourage their companions so they're all ready when destiny calls.

entries.name: Oath of Glory
entries.summary: Strive for the Heights of Heroism Paladins who take the Oath of Glory believe they and their companions are destined to achieve glory through deeds of heroism. They train diligently and encourage their companions, so they're all ready when destiny calls. These paladins share the following tenets: - Endeavor to be known by your deeds. - Face hardships with courage. - Inspire others to strive for glory.

entries.name: Oath of Glory
entries.summary: Paladins who take the Oath of Glory believe they and their companions are destined to achieve glory through deeds of heroism. They train diligently and encourage their companions so they’re all ready when destiny calls.

entries.name: Oath of Heroism
entries.summary: The Oath of Heroism is an affirmation of a destined path, one laid out for you by divine hands.

entries.name: Oath of Judgment
entries.summary: You have sworn to balance the cosmic scales of the universe.

entries.name: Oath of Predation
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: Paladins who follow the Oath of Predation believe that the world can only be made perfect through utter control.

entries.name: Oath of Providence
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: Paladins who take the Oath of Providence believe they are the hand of destiny, striking down enemies beyond redemption.

entries.name: Oath of Radiance
entries.summary: The Oath of Radiance is almost as old as the sun that it follows, and has remained a steady force of good over the ages. Often called sun warriors or shining knights, paladins that take this oath seek to bring light and knowledge to even the darkest areas of the world.

entries.name: Oath of Redemption
entries.summary: The Oath of Redemption sets a paladin on a difficult path, one that requires a holy warrior to use violence only as a last resort.

entries.name: Oath of Sarshel
entries.summary: You focus on the elimination of fiendish and undead creatures that still threaten Impiltur and the eastern reaches of Faerûn.

entries.name: Oath of the Ancients
entries.summary: The Oath of the Ancients is as old as the race of elves and the rituals of the druids. Sometimes called fey knights, green knights, or horned knights, paladins who swear this oath cast their lot with the side of the light in the cosmic struggle against darkness because they love the beautiful and life-giving things of the world, not necessarily because they believe in principles of honor, courage, and justice.

entries.name: Oath of the Ancients
entries.summary: Preserve Life and Light in the World The Oath of the Ancients is as old as the first elves. Paladins who swear this oath cherish the light; they love the beautiful and life-giving things of the world more than any principles of honor, courage, and justice.

entries.name: Oath of the Crown
entries.summary: The Oath of the Crown is sworn to the ideals of civilization, be it the spirit of a nation, fealty to a sovereign, or service to a deity of law and rulership.

entries.name: Oath of the Dragonlord
entries.summary: Dragonlords are paladins who seek to extend their reach across the land by binding a dragon into their service.

entries.name: Oath of the Forebearer
entries.summary: These holy warriors are connected to the sunlit plane of Irian more than any creatures saving the Undying themselves.

entries.name: Oath of the Giving Grave
entries.summary: The giving grave is more a philosophy than a formalized code.

entries.name: Oath of the Grave
entries.summary: The Oath of the Grave is a seldom practised tradition, most commonly reserved for the followers of the Raven Queen. Sometimes called winter knights, black knights, or grave knights, these paladins serve as protectors of the sacred passings into the afterlife.

entries.name: Oath of the Janessar
entries.summary: The Oath of the Janessar commits a paladin to overthrowing tyranny and liberating the oppressed. This can involve tasks as diverse as freeing a slave, saving someone from a forced marriage, or ensuring workers receive a fair wage.

entries.name: Oath of the North Star
entries.publication: All the Lights in the Sky are Stars
entries.summary: Knights who swear an oath to the north star aid and guide travelers along their way. They take after the star itself, reliable and steadfast in even the darkest of times.

entries.name: Oath of the Shacklebreaker
entries.summary: A holy warriors dedicated to freeing the enslaved souls of the Nine Hells.

entries.name: Oath of the Watchers
entries.summary: The Oath of the Watchers binds paladins to protect mortal realms from the predations of extraplanar creatures, many of which can lay waste to mortal soldiers. Thus, the Watchers hone their minds, spirits, and bodies to be the ultimate weapons against such threats.

entries.name: Oath of the Watchers
entries.summary: You protect the mortal realm from the predations of extraplanar creatures.

entries.name: Oath of Treachery
entries.summary: The Oath of Treachery is the path followed by paladins who have forsworn other oaths or who care only for their own power and survival. Commonly known as blackguards, these profane warriors are faithful only to themselves.

entries.name: Oath of Vengeance
entries.summary: The Oath of Vengeance is a solemn commitment to punish those who have committed a grievous sin. When evil forces slaughter helpless villagers, when an entire people turns against the will of the gods, when a thieves’ guild grows too violent and powerful, when a dragon rampages through the countryside—at times like these, paladins arise and swear an Oath of Vengeance to set right that which has gone wrong.

entries.name: Oath of Vengeance
entries.summary: Punish Evildoers at Any Cost The Oath of Vengeance is a solemn commitment to punish those who have committed grievously evil acts. When evil armies slaughter helpless villagers, when a tyrant defies the will of the gods, when a thieves' guild grows too violent, when a dragon rampages through the countryside—at times like these, paladins arise and swear an Oath of Vengeance to set right what has gone wrong.

entries.name: Oathbreaker
entries.summary: An Oathbreaker is a paladin who breaks his or her sacred oaths to pursue some dark ambition or serve an evil power.

entries.name: Odyssean
entries.summary: Odysseans are legendary tricksters who at first glance seem like common soldiers.

entries.name: Onomancy
entries.summary: Practitioners of magic well know the power of names, but wizards who follow the tradition of Onomancy use their magic to manipulate the words that encompass existence.

entries.name: Order Domain
entries.summary: The Order Domain represents discipline, as well as devotion to a society or an institution and strict obedience to the laws governing it.

entries.name: Order Domain
entries.summary: The Order Domain represents discipline, as well as devotion to the laws that govern a society, an institution, or a philosophy. Clerics of Order meditate on logic and justice as they serve their gods, examples of which appear in the Order Deities table.

entries.name: Order Domain
entries.summary: The Order domain represents discipline, as well as service to a society or an institution, whether that service is rendered in obedience to or enforcement of the law—civil, religious, or both.

entries.name: Order of Scribes
entries.summary: Magic of the book—that’s what many folk call wizardry. The name is apt, given how much time wizards spend poring over tomes and penning theories about the nature of magic. It’s rare to see wizards traveling without books and scrolls sprouting from their bags, and a wizard would go to great lengths to plumb an archive of ancient knowledge.

entries.name: Order of Scribes
entries.summary: Magic of the book—that’s what many spellcasters call wizardry. The name is apt, given how much time wizards spend poring over their spellbooks, penning theories about the nature of magic, and exploring the farthest recesses of libraries.

entries.name: Order of the Avatar
entries.summary: Mystics of the Order of the Avatar delve into the world of emotion.

entries.name: Order of the Awakened
entries.summary: Mystics dedicated to the Order of the Awakened seek to unlock the full potential of the mind.

entries.name: Order of the Ghostslayer
entries.summary: The Order of the Ghostslayer is the oldest and most driven of the orders, having rediscovered the secrets of blood magic and refined them for combat against the scourge of undeath.

entries.name: Order of the Ghostslayer
entries.summary: The Order of the Ghostslayer is the oldest of the orders, having originally rediscovered the secrets of blood magic and refined them for combat against the scourge of undeath. Ghostslayers seek out and study the moment of death, obsessing over the mysteries of the transition and how it can become corrupted by unholy powers to rise once more.

entries.name: Order of the Immortal
entries.summary: The Order of the Immortal uses psionic energy to augment and modify the physical form.

entries.name: Order of the Lycan
entries.summary: The process of consuming the Hunter’s Bane is a painful, scarring, and often fatal experience.

entries.name: Order of the Lycan
entries.summary: Of the many terrible curses that plague the realm, few are as ancient or as feared as Lycanthropy. Passed through blood, this affliction seeds a host with the savage strength and hunger for violence of a wicked beast.

entries.name: Order of the Mutant
entries.summary: The process of consuming the Hunter’s Bane is a painful, scarring, and often fatal experience.

entries.name: Order of the Mutant
entries.summary: The process of the Hunter’s Bane is a painful, scarring, and sometimes fatal experience. Those that survive find themselves irrevocably changed, enhanced. Some found this experience exalting, embracing the ability to alter one’s own physiology through a combination of hemocraft and corrupted alchemy.

entries.name: Order of the Nomad
entries.summary: Mystics of the Order of the Nomad keep their minds in a strange, rarified state. They seek to accumulate as much knowledge as possible.

entries.name: Order of the Profane Soul
entries.summary: The magics adopted by the wayward blood hunter prove formidable against many an evil across the realm.

entries.name: Order of the Profane Soul
entries.summary: Those who have taken to the Order of the Profane Soul have seen the limits of hemocraft against some of the most ancient and cruel fiends and terrors of the world. Unable to pursue beings of such power, creatures able to vanish amongst the nobles without a trace, or bend the mind of the most stalwart warrior with but a glance, this order trusted in their resilience and delved into this same well of corrupting arcane…

entries.name: Order of the Soul Knife
entries.summary: The Order of the Soul Knife mystics learn to manifest a deadly weapon of pure psychic energy that they can use to cleave through foes.

entries.name: Order of the Wu Jen
entries.summary: The Order of the Wu Jen mystics cast their minds into the world, and rebuild it.

entries.name: Packleader’s Presence
entries.summary: While Warlords may specialize in the control of battles, n Packleader is a Warlord that aims to win a fight before it becomes a battle. Through scouting, preparing, and stacking the odds, they don’t fight fair, they fight to win, and seek to only fight when they’ve already won.

entries.name: Paragon’s Presence
entries.summary: Legends tell of warriors that fight at the front of a legion, of the valor they display and the inspiration it gives their comrades. A Paragon before their army is a dauntless foe, and an army behind their Paragon is an unstoppable legion.

entries.name: Path of Blood
entries.summary: The Path of Blood is a path taken by only the most ruthless and battle-hungry barbarians. They do not care when they shed their own blood - in fact, they use that energy to empower their rage even farther, using their suffering to inflict wounds upon their foes through magical bonds of blood.

entries.name: Path of Sacred Kin
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: As in all civilizations, stories of life’s origin are intertwined with the path of mythical beings consorting among them out of grand purpose or boredom. These stories, told since the first sunrise, act as guiding parables when a tribe or people faces a crucial juncture in their fate.

entries.name: Path of the Accursed
entries.summary: The true source of your furious rage is both defiance and acceptance of the madness that lies within the Accursed Archive.

entries.name: Path of the Ancestral Guardian
entries.summary: Some barbarians hail from cultures that revere their ancestors.

entries.name: Path of the Battlerager
entries.summary: Known as Kuldjargh (literally "axe idiot") in Dwarvish, battleragers are dwarf followers of the gods of war and take the Path of the Battlerager.

entries.name: Path of the Beast
entries.summary: Barbarians who walk the Path of the Beast draw their rage from a bestial spark burning within their souls. That beast bursts forth in the throes of rage, physically transforming the barbarian.

entries.name: Path of the Beast
entries.summary: You draw their rage from a bestial spark burning within their souls.

entries.name: Path of the Berserker
entries.summary: The Path of the Berserker is a path of untrammeled fury, slick with blood.

entries.name: Path of the Berserker
entries.summary: Channel Rage into Violent Fury Barbarians who walk the Path of the Berserker direct their Rage primarily toward violence. Their path is one of untrammeled fury, and they thrill in the chaos of battle as they allow their Rage to seize and empower them.

entries.name: Path of the Blazing Sun
entries.summary: There are many cultures, particularly in the harsh outlands that many barbarians call home, that revere the power of the sun. Barbarians who follow the Path of the Blazing Sun take this reverence a step further, and learn to how to transform and harness this power.

entries.name: Path of the Celestial Avatar
entries.summary: Some barbarians revere the celestial spirits that roam the lands and skies, and seek them out to be their guides and personal connection to the divine. A few barbarian clans have pre-established connections to celestial spirits, and for those clans taking this path is merely proving yourself worthy of that creature’s power.

entries.name: Path of the Comet
entries.publication: All the Lights in the Sky are Stars
entries.summary: Blasting across the battlefield in a shell of fire and ice, barbarians who follow the path of the comet are blessed with tremendous speed and power. As with the celestial voyagers that pass overhead, so too do these warriors put on brilliant displays, engraved in the hearts and minds of those that witness them.

entries.name: Path of the Courageous Heart
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: A guardian of the weak, and what you lack in polish you make up for in valor.

entries.name: Path of the Giant
entries.publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
entries.summary: Barbarians who walk the Path of the Giant draw strength from the same primal forces as giants. As they rage, these barbarians surge with elemental power and grow in size, taking on forms that evoke the glory of giants.

entries.name: Path of the Giant
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: Barbarians who walk the Path of the Giant draw strength from the primal forces that are the Giants and their elemental ilk. Their rages surge with elemental power and cause these barbarians to grow in size, transforming them into avatars of primordial might.

entries.name: Path of the Juggernaut
entries.summary: When the Herd of Storms led their terrible raids across the continent under the leadership of Kevdak, tales spread of their bloodlust, brutality, and nigh unstoppable strength. Walls crumbled and legions fell to but a handful of fearsome warriors as they cut a path for the herd to charge in and take what they wished before vanishing back into the Dividing Plains.

entries.name: Path of the Mercurial
entries.summary: Your rage is not rage at all. Instead, you are filled with a malicious spite that runs wild within your veins, bringing a cruel smile to your face and causing the shadows around you to writhe and twist in sympathy.

entries.name: Path of the Red Reaver
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: A warrior’s hunt for meaning in a life borne of suffering and violence.

entries.name: Path of the Storm Herald
entries.summary: Storm heralds are typically elite champions who train alongside druids, rangers, and others sworn to protect nature.

entries.name: Path of the Totem Warrior
entries.summary: The Path of the Totem Warrior is a spiritual journey, as the barbarian accepts a spirit animal as guide, protector, and inspiration.

entries.name: Path of the Wild Heart
entries.summary: Walk in Community with the Animal World Barbarians who follow the Path of the Wild Heart view themselves as kin to animals. These Barbarians learn magical means to communicate with animals, and their Rage heightens their connection to animals as it fills them with supernatural might.

entries.name: Path of the Wild Soul
entries.summary: The realm of the Feywild abounds with beauty, unpredictable emotion, and rampant magic. A barbarian exposed to this realm feels emotions powerfully and magic saturates their body. When a barbarian who follows this path rages, it is a bellowing roar for freedom, an explosion of expression, manifesting in unpredictable ways.

entries.name: Path of the Winter Heart
entries.summary: Barbarians of the Winter Heart embrace the ever-hungering cold of Risia.

entries.name: Path of the World Tree
entries.summary: Trace the Roots and Branches of the Multiverse Barbarians who follow the Path of the World Tree connect with the cosmic tree Yggdrasil through their Rage. This tree grows among the Outer Planes, connecting them to each other and the Material Plane. These Barbarians draw on the tree’s magic for vitality and as a means of dimensional travel.

entries.name: Path of the Zealot
entries.summary: Rage in Ecstatic Union with a God Barbarians who walk the Path of the Zealot receive boons from a god or pantheon. These Barbarians experience their Rage as an ecstatic episode of divine union that infuses them with power. They are often allies to the priests and other followers of their god or pantheon.

entries.name: Path of the Zealot
entries.summary: Some deities inspire their followers to pitch themselves into a ferocious battle fury. These barbarians are zealots— warriors who channel their rage into powerful displays of divine power.

entries.name: Path of Wild Magic
entries.summary: Many places in the multiverse abound with beauty, intense emotion, and rampant magic; the Feywild, the Upper Planes, and other realms of supernatural power radiate with such forces and can profoundly influence people.

entries.name: Peace Domain
entries.summary: The balm of peace thrives at the heart of healthy communities, between friendly nations, and in the souls of the kindhearted. The gods of peace inspire people of all sorts to resolve conflict and to stand up against those forces that try to prevent peace from flourishing.

entries.name: Phantom
entries.summary: Many rogues walk a fine line between life and death, risking their own lives and taking the lives of others. While adventuring on that line, some rogues discover a mystical connection to death itself.

entries.name: Phantom
entries.summary: Many rogues walk a fine line between life and death, risking their own lives and taking the lives of others. While adventuring on that line, some rogues discover a mystical connection to death itself.

entries.name: Phoenix Sorcery
entries.summary: Your power draws from the immortal flame that fuels the legendary phoenix.

entries.name: Plague & Poison
entries.summary: Just when a disease or toxin brought you to the brink of death, your fever broke and you survived. The foreign element that nearly killed you left a stain on your soul, giving you an unnatural affinity for plagues and poisons. Some spiritualists of this threshold appear perpetually ill or afflicted by the toxin that nearly killed them.

entries.name: Plague Domain
entries.summary: You live to study the morbid steps of deadly diseases.

entries.name: Prescient Knight
entries.summary: TThe culmination of long years of study, practice, and dedication to the craft of combat divination.

entries.name: Primeval Guardian
entries.summary: Rangers of the Primeval Guardian Conclave follow an ancient tradition rooted in powerful druidic magic.

entries.name: Prophecy Domain
entries.summary: The Prophecy domain focuses on foretelling danger and preventing harmful outcomes.

entries.name: Protection Domain
entries.summary: The protection domain is the purview of deities who charge their followers to shield the weak from the strong. The gods’ faithful dwell in villages and towns on the borderlands, where they help bolster defenses and seek out evils to defeat.

entries.name: Psi Knight
entries.summary: Awake to the psionic power within, a Psi Knight is a fighter who augments their physical might with psi-infused weapon strikes, telekinetic lashes, and barriers of mental force. Many githyanki train to become such knights, as do some of the most disciplined high elves.

entries.name: Psi Warrior
entries.summary: Augment Physical Might with Psionic Power Psi Warriors awaken the power of their minds to augment their physical might. They harness this psionic power to infuse their weapon strikes, lash out with telekinetic energy, and create barriers of mental force.

entries.name: Psi Warrior
entries.summary: Awake to the psionic power within, a Psi Warrior is a fighter who augments their physical might with psi-infused weapon strikes, telekinetic lashes, and barriers of mental force. Many githyanki train to become such warriors, as do some of the most disciplined high elves.

entries.name: Psionic Soul
entries.summary: One day a light blazed forth within you—the illumination of psionic power. Your mind now simmers with this power, the full extent of which you won’t fully grasp for years to come. You can touch other minds with it and alter the world around you by using it to control the magical energy of the multiverse.

entries.name: Psionics
entries.summary: Wizards who follow the tradition of Psionics hone the magical potential of their own minds.

entries.name: Psychic Warrior
entries.summary: A Psionic Warrior is a Fighter who is deadly in both mind and body, lethal in both thought and action. Gifted, blessed, cursed, burdened, or born with Psionic powers, when these powers manifest upon taking this archetype, the Fighter transitions into a terrifying foe, unbounded by any natural laws.

entries.name: Psychic Warrior
entries.summary: A fighter who augments their physical might with psychically infused weapon strikes, telekinetic lashes, and barriers of mental force.

entries.name: Purple Dragon Knight
entries.summary: Purple Dragon knights are warriors who hail from the kingdom of Cormyr

entries.name: Pyromancer
entries.summary: Your innate magic manifests in fire. You are your fire, and your fire is you.

entries.name: Raumathari Battlemage
entries.summary: You mastered an innate connection to the principles of war and the art of combat.

entries.name: Reaper
entries.summary: The village is quiet during the strangers walk down the roads. No birds are chirping, no children heard playing, no wind blowing. He bends over to grab a flower but it withers before even touched.

entries.name: Relic Hunter
entries.summary: A treasure seeker versed in sifting the debris strewn battlefields of Avernus.

entries.name: Requiem of the Ash
entries.summary: Requiem of the Ash Grave Wardens focus on the ebbs and flows of life and death.

entries.name: Requiem of the Frigid
entries.summary: Requiem of the Frigid Grave Wardens bring a cold gripping death to their foes.

entries.name: Requiem of the Haunt
entries.summary: Requiem of the Haunt Grave Wardens live in the shadows. They are able to spread their influence to snuff out light and enjoy terrifying their foes with thoughts of the unknown.

entries.name: Requiem of the Torpor
entries.summary: Requiem of the Torpor Grave Wardens drain the very energy out of their victims while spreading death and decay upon the battle field.

entries.name: Ring Warden
entries.summary: The dwarves long ago discovered the means to imbue magic into metal rings, and the ring wardens were born.

entries.name: Rune Knight
entries.summary: Rune Knights enhance their martial prowess using the supernatural power of runes, and ancient practice that originated with giants. Rune cutters can be found among any family of giants, and you likely learned your methods first or second hand from such a mystical artisan.

entries.name: Rune Knight
entries.summary: You discovered how to enhance your martial prowess using the supernatural power of runes.

entries.name: Runechild
entries.summary: A runechild uses their bodies as tortured spell batteries for their own diabolic pursuits.

entries.name: Runecrafter
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: Runecrafter wizards enhance their spellcasting through the ancient power of runes. Though the tradition originated with the giant rune casters of old, runecraft magic has expanded to encompass countless languages and practitioners across different worlds.

entries.name: Runeguard
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: A seeker of magical power within ancient languages, and to hasten the speed of their blade and strengthen of their armor by imbuing them with the power of these runes.

entries.name: Salt and Vinegar
entries.summary: Pugilists in the Salt & Vinegar fight club revel in their reputations as heels.

entries.name: Samurai
entries.summary: The Samurai is a fighter who draws on an implacable fighting spirit to overcome enemies. A Samurai’s resolve is nearly unbreakable, and the enemies in a Samurai's path have two choices: yield or die fighting.

entries.name: Savager
entries.summary: Savagers learn to channel the strength of its most primal spirits through specific stances, taking on aspects of different animals.

entries.name: School of Abjuration
entries.summary: The School of Abjuration emphasizes magic that blocks, banishes, or protects. Detractors of this school say that its tradition is about denial, negation rather than positive assertion.

entries.name: School of Astronomy
entries.publication: All the Lights in the Sky are Stars
entries.summary: The observation of the stars and celestial bodies of the greater universe is known as astronomy, with wizards who practice this tradition being known as astronomers. They study the different properties of the stars, and learn to create their own miniature celestial bodies.

entries.name: School of Blood Magic
entries.summary: A blood mage powers his magic with the secrets he learns from his own blood.

entries.name: School of Chaos
entries.summary: Wizards who specialize in chaos magic crave an understanding of probability and life’s unpredictable outcomes to the point of obsession.

entries.name: School of Clockwork
entries.summary: The school of clockwork magic is a blending of technology and magic not oten seen.

entries.name: School of Conjuration
entries.summary: As a conjurer, you favor spells that produce objects and creatures out of thin air.

entries.name: School of Divination
entries.summary: The counsel of a diviner is sought by royalty and commoners alike, for all seek a clearer understanding of the past, present, and future.

entries.name: School of Elven High Magic
entries.summary: With high magic and sufficient time, an elven wizard can accomplish just about anything.

entries.name: School of Enchantment
entries.summary: As a member of the School of Enchantment, you have honed your ability to magically entrance and beguile other people and monsters.

entries.name: School of Evocation
entries.summary: You focus your study on magic that creates powerful elemental effects such as bitter cold, searing flame, rolling thunder, crackling lightning, and burning acid.

entries.name: School of Heliomancy
entries.summary: As a heliomancer, you focus your studies on the magical energy of the sun, and use it to create powerful bursts of radiance and dazzling displays of light. Though much of your magic is normally considered divine, you have managed to emulate these same spells and effects through rigorous study and careful experimentation.

entries.name: School of Hemomancy
entries.summary: The School of Hemomancy studies the ancient arcane art of blood magic.

entries.name: School of Illumination
entries.summary: Illuminators, use the stars to predict when danger is near, and draw on the power of darkness to atack their foes.

entries.name: School of Illusion
entries.summary: You focus your studies on magic that dazzles the senses, befuddles the mind, and tricks even the wisest folk.

entries.name: School of Invention
entries.summary: The School of Invention claims credit for inventing the other schools of magic - a claim other wizards find absurd. Wizards of this school push magic to its limits. They stretch the known laws of arcane power and strive to reveal important truths about the nature of the multiverse.

entries.name: School of Necromancy
entries.summary: The School of Necromancy explores the cosmic forces of life, death, and undeath.

entries.name: School of Pyromancy
entries.summary: As a member of the School of Pyromancy, you have honed your ability to harness the destructive power of elemental fire. Though this school is often considered a sub-branch of the School of Evocation, it also employs the use of transmutation magic that controls fire, and is overall more specialized than an evoker.

entries.name: School of Reawakening
entries.summary: Members of the school of reawakening combine the forces of necromancy with the power of conjuration.

entries.name: School of Reconstruction
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: You focus your study on manipulating magic in a way that turns the destructive power of arcane evocation into rejuvenating magic.

entries.name: School of Revelation
entries.summary: You dive everdeeper into forbidden knowledge that can serve as powerful tools and come out the other side forever changed.

entries.name: School of Transmutation
entries.summary: You are a student of spells that modify energy and matter.

entries.name: Scout
entries.summary: Scouts excels at finding safe passage through dangerous regions.

entries.name: Scout
entries.summary: Combines stealth with a knack for survival

entries.name: Sea Sorcerer
entries.summary: Your heritage ties to powerful creatures of the sea.

entries.name: Serophage
entries.summary: You have always been preoccupied with blood, both your own and that of others.

entries.name: Shadow Bloodline
entries.summary: Your magic comes from a place drained of color, where light fights a losing battle against the relentless encroachment of darkness.

entries.name: Shadow Magic
entries.summary: Your power draws from the Shadowfell itself.

entries.name: Shadow
entries.summary: Some rogues choose to delve into the intricacies of shadow magic, using its unique powers to enhance their skills in stealth and deception. These rogues are a very diverse subset, from simple thieves to hired killers to highly trained bounty hunters. By learning how to separate their shadow from their body, shadow rogues become difficult to catch and even harder to kill.

entries.name: Shadowsilk Couturier
entries.summary: Your tapestry is far closer to its namesake than most others, manifesting as a cloak embroidered with razor-sharp blades and imbued with potent illusion magic. It moves at your command, twitching, grasping, and cutting at your leisure. You aren’t entirely sure if it obeys your conscious thoughts or your subconscious mind, but either way, it is always watching your back. Raise your hood, or raise your blades.

entries.name: Shaper
entries.summary: A Shaper is a Psion that specializes in the materialization of their imagination, projecting it out into the world. No mere conjurers borrowing the powers of other planes, a Shaper manifests things from nothing but their own mind, weaving their creations into existence through the exertion of raw psionic power and imagination.

entries.name: Sharpshooter
entries.summary: The Sharpshooter is a master of ranged combat. An excellent sniper and eagle-eyed scout, this fighter is a perilous foe who can defeat an entire war band so long as they are kept at range.

entries.name: Shooting Star
entries.publication: All the Lights in the Sky are Stars
entries.summary: Rangers of the Shooting Star conclave emulate the brilliant displays of astral bodies streaking across the sky. Their arrows strike with the intensity and variety of these extraterrestrial phenomenon.

entries.name: Shou Disciple
entries.summary: You seek to focus on the practical aspects of martial combat.

entries.name: Sky Domain
entries.publication: All the Lights in the Sky are Stars
entries.summary: The gods that govern the sky are held in high regard by many religions. Deities of the sky include Zeus and Tyr, among various others. Followers of these deities often travel far to sate their wanderlust and feel the beauty of the open sky

entries.name: Solidarity Domain
entries.summary: The Solidarity domain is granted to those who follow the teachings of the God-Pharaoh Oketra.

entries.name: Soul Gatherer Domain
entries.summary: Collectors of lost spirits and souls, able to draw upon their etherial host for power.

entries.name: Soulknife
entries.summary: Strike Foes with Psionic Blades A Soulknife strikes with the mind, cutting through barriers both physical and psychic. These Rogues discover psionic power within themselves and channel it to do their roguish work.

entries.name: Soulknife
entries.summary: Most assassins strike with physical weapons, and many burglars and spies use thieves’ tools to infiltrate secure locations. In contrast, a Soulknife strikes and infiltrates the mind, cutting through barriers both physical and psychic.

entries.name: Soulknife
entries.summary: A Soulknife possesses powerful psionic potential.

entries.name: Soulknife
entries.summary: Most assassins strike with physical weapons, and many burglars and spies use thieves’ tools to infiltrate secure locations, whereas a Soulknife strikes and infiltrates with the mind, cutting through barriers both physical and psychic.

entries.name: Sous Chef
entries.summary: Sous Chef believes that their allies are more than worthy of their cooking.

entries.name: Spellsword
entries.summary: Spellswords are fast-moving skirmishers. Masters at navigating a battlefield, they use their magic to approach their enemies, deal empowered strikes with their weapons, then quickly reposition to a more favorable location.

entries.name: Spidertouched
entries.summary: You’ve learned your craft from the Weaver of Lies itself.

entries.name: Star Spawn
entries.publication: All the Lights in the Sky are Stars
entries.summary: Star Spawn sorcerers inherit their magic from the mysterious creatures of the same name from the far reaches. Their magic is one of spatial manipulation and psychic energies, allowing them to move and cast spells in unpredictable and disruptive ways. The birth of a Star Spawn sorcerer occurs in the wake of a comet passing overhead, and forebodes the arrival of Elder Evils.

entries.name: Starspiral Couturier
entries.summary: Your tapestry is woven from the light of the stars themselves, forming an armor around your body. It is strangely mechanical, yet smooth and comforting. Powered by your will and your brilliant arcane energy while moving in tandem with your body, this suit acts as an extension of your infusion, allowing you to stride across the battlefield as a massive harbinger of hope and destruction.

entries.name: Stone Sorcerer
entries.summary: Your magic springs from a mystical link between your soul and the magic of elemental earth.

entries.name: Stoneheart
entries.summary: Your blood comes from a steadfast lineage, touched by the elemental forces of the earth itself. Be it the blood of ancient dwarves first formed from stone or from a dao lineage from another plane, your blood runs thicker and your heart beats more steady than others.

entries.name: Storm Sorcery
entries.summary: Your innate magic comes from the power of elemental air.

entries.name: Story Domain
entries.summary: You do not say prayers but instead recite passages of inspiring stories from memory.

entries.name: Strength Domain
entries.summary: The Strength domain is granted to those who follow the teachings of the God-Pharaoh Rhonas.

entries.name: Survival Domain
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: Clerics and shamans of primitive tribes living in harsh environments have no greater mission than ensuring the survival of their tribes.

entries.name: Swarmkeeper
entries.summary: Feeling a deep connection to the environment around them, some rangers reach out through their magical connection to the world and bond with a swarm of nature spirits. The swarm becomes a potent force in battle, as well as helpful company for the ranger.

entries.name: Swarmkeeper
entries.summary: Feeling a deep connection to the world around them, some rangers reach out through their magical connection to nature and gather a host of fey spirits, which take the form of swarming beasts—be they buzzing insects, fluttering birds, slippery squids, or otherwise.

entries.name: Swashbuckler
entries.summary: You focus your training on the art of the blade, relying on speed, elegance, and charm in equal parts.

entries.name: Tactic Mastery
entries.summary: The Tactic Mastery archetype specialises in uncanny tactics to be able to lead anyone they fight alongside to victory. Those who model themselves on this archetype have exceptional skill in making strategies during battle and have unbreakable willpower.

entries.name: Tactician’s Presence
entries.summary: A Tactician may very well tell you they would just as soon not be close enough to the battle to be considered a combatant, preferring to win their fights before it ever gets to that stage, but one would be a fool to underestimate how dangerous they are once on the battlefield.

entries.name: Technomancy
entries.summary: Technomancers can make use of technology as both conduit and a storage space for magic.

entries.name: Tempest Domain
entries.summary: Gods whose portfolios include the Tempest domain govern storms, sea, and sky.

entries.name: The Accursed Archive
entries.summary: In every library there is a book that has never been read, a section that has never been seen, and a hallway that leads to nowhere – yet, you have managed to read that tome of unspoken secrets, find that shelf of unholy blasphemies, and step beyond the dead-end corridor into the Accursed Archive, where you have become bound to the nightmare inducing writings within.

entries.name: The Arcane Order
entries.summary: The Arcane Order is an eldritch society built on mentorstudent relationships. While the Order is unified in name, each member tends to operate alone or with only their mentor or apprentice—though in times of extreme circumstance, members will come together to face grave, large scale threats.

entries.name: The Archfey
entries.summary: Your patron is a lord or lady of the fey, a creature of legend who holds secrets that were forgotten before the mortal races were born.

entries.name: The Archlich
entries.summary: You have made a pact with an archlich, a creature that has existed since the dawn of the last age and holds secrets of arcane magic that have been forgotten for thousands of years.

entries.name: The Ashen Wolf
entries.summary: You’ve made a pact with a primal spirit of fire and the hunt – a scourge of the forests and fields, and a harbinger of ill fate. This creature is wise and cunning, making deals with those who have the potential to bring ruin and change.

entries.name: The Blackthorn Grove
entries.summary: You’ve torn out your heart as an offering to the Blackthorn Grove after braving the Maze of Blood and resisting the temptations of the Fields of Acedia. In place of your heart, a pulsing, beating, writhing mass of thorns has grown and made you whole.

entries.name: The Celestial
entries.summary: Your patron is a powerful being of the Upper Planes.

entries.name: The Chaos
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: You have made a pact with a creature that revels in the madness and infinite possibility of the chaotic planes.

entries.name: The Currency Conspiracy
entries.summary: Hushed whispers fill your mind, informing you that your memories are your own. You don’t quite understand what that means, but it seems that the Cabal may have a grand plan that requires your action and needs you to be aware of the reality behind your deeds.

entries.name: The Dark
entries.summary: You have bound yourself to a creature of the Endless Night that frequents the darkness surrounding the cities of the drow and other vile races.

entries.name: The Elder Sphinx
entries.summary: You have made a pact with an ancient sphinx born in a bygone age, a being made manifest through the power of devout prayer or the direct intervention of the gods. Such beings are tasked with guarding the secrets and treasures of the gods, and revealing those secrets to those that pass their trials and show their worth.

entries.name: The Eternal Citadel
entries.summary: You’ve made a pact with the Eternal Citadel, a massive yet empty bastion that seems to wander between worlds.

entries.name: The Fallen Exile
entries.summary: Stars beyond measure populate the void beyond the world while celestial spheres circle above. You have met with one of their number, cast down by the many cold and unfeeling suns above for the sin of falling in love with a mortal.

entries.name: The Fates
entries.summary: Your otherworldy patron is actually a trio of ancient beings: the coven of hags known as the Fates. The Fates weave the destinies of all gods and mortals in their magical loom, but whether they manipulate fate or merely record it is unknown.

entries.name: The Fathomless
entries.summary: You have plunged into a pact with the deeps. An entity of the ocean, the Elemental Plane of Water, or another otherworldly sea now allows you to draw on its thalassic power. Is it merely using you to learn about terrestrial realms, or does it want you to open cosmic floodgates and drown the world?

entries.name: The Fiend
entries.summary: You have made a pact with a fiend from the lower planes of existence.

entries.name: The Firebird
entries.summary: Your patron is a mighty phoenix, a creature of the elemental plane of fire. While ordinary phoenixes do not have the intelligence to make such a pact, particularly powerful ones, known as firebirds, can bestow great elemental power to a warlock.

entries.name: The Forbidden Graveyard
entries.summary: You’ve stepped into the Forbidden Graveyard, a sanctuary found on the boundary between life and death, where the rare few whose minds are attuned to this place come to wander as their bodies heal or slip away into the cold clutches of the night.

entries.name: The Frozen One
entries.summary: Your patron is the embodiment of winter.

entries.name: The Gelatinous Convocation
entries.summary: You’ve made a pact with the cheerful wandering cubes of sentient ooze that wiggle and wobble their way across the multiverse.

entries.name: The Genie Lord
entries.summary: You have made a pact with a powerful ruler of genie kind on one of the Elemental Planes.

entries.name: The Genie
entries.summary: You have made a pact with one of the rarest kinds of genie, a noble genie. Such entities rule vast fiefs on the Elemental Planes and have great influence over lesser genies and elemental creatures.

entries.name: The Genie
entries.summary: You have made a pact with one of the rarest kinds of genie, a noble genie. Such entities are rulers of vast fiefs on the Elemental Planes and have great influence over lesser genies and elemental creatures.

entries.name: The Gray Portrait
entries.summary: Your dedication to art and beauty has led you to discover the art of creating a Gray Portrait: an artifact that your soul and body are bound to that channels the ambitions you have always held but never revealed.

entries.name: The Great Machine
entries.summary: Your patron is a being of cold precision, to a degree beyond mortal measure.

entries.name: The Great Old One
entries.summary: Your patron is a mysterious entity whose nature is utterly foreign to the fabric of reality.

entries.name: The Great Tree
entries.summary: The inimitable princes of the Feywild are not the only source of power in the enchanted forests and magical jungles of that realm.

entries.name: The Hexblade
entries.summary: You have made your pact with a mysterious entity from the Shadowfell.

entries.name: The Keeper of the Depths
entries.summary: You’ve made a pact with an ancient oceanic entity known as the Keeper of the Depths.

entries.name: The Knights Stygian
entries.summary: The Knights Stygian take it upon themselves to seek out and cleanse the world of its corruption. These magi seek to protect the innocent, defend the weak, and ensure justice is done. They do this by wielding necromantic magic that simultaneously terrifies their living foes and turns their defeated foes into foot soldiers in the magi’s service.

entries.name: The Light-Eater
entries.summary: You have made a pact with a being from the Plane of Shadows whose goal is to plunge the world into unending darkness.

entries.name: The Lurker in the Deep
entries.summary: You made a pact with an entity that lurks somewhere deep in the ocean, or even on the Elemental Plane of Water.

entries.name: The Nebula
entries.publication: All the Lights in the Sky are Stars
entries.summary: Your patron is a cloud of interstellar gas, chaotic and raw. You have bound yourself to this primeval being, allowing you to bear the power of creation that is the nebula’s nature. The nebula is a chaotic force of creation, and its desire to spawn new things into being are imparted upon its warlocks.

entries.name: The Noble Genie
entries.summary: You made a pact with one of the rarest of geniekind, a noble genie.

entries.name: The Noble Genie
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: Your pact is one that has been made by legendary advisors, philosophers, and tale-spinners of the desert lands, known throughout the land of Zakhara as sha’irs.

entries.name: The Perfect Chord
entries.summary: You have heard the most sublime sound in the world, and it has changed you forever. You’ve taken the resonance into your beating heart and it has brought meaning and inspiration to your days.

entries.name: The Primordial Seal
entries.summary: The Primordial Seal claims to be an ancient order responsible for the ongoing safety of the material realms. According to their own lore, the material realms were–in ancient times–constantly besieged by the elemental realms until a seal was placed, forever separating them from one another.

entries.name: The Queen of Air and Darkness
entries.summary: Your patron is an invisible and evil fey presence in the heart of Pandemonium

add.value: The Queen of Air and Darkness

entries.name: The Raven Queen
entries.summary: You patron is the Raven Queen, a mysterious being who rules the Shadowfell from a palace of ice deep within that dread realm.

entries.name: The Revived
entries.summary: You’ve had a soul-shaking realization: you’ve been dead before, yet somehow you are alive again.

entries.name: The Seeker
entries.summary: Your patron is an inscrutable being who travels the Astral Plane in search of knowledge and secrets.

entries.name: The Serpent Empress
entries.summary: Situated within her palace of gold and turquoise, the Serpent Empress sleeps in serene silence, guiding her slaves to serve in her secret business. Envious and vain, the Empress personifies greed and avarice in the hearts of man.

entries.name: The Shadow Cabal
entries.summary: Your patron is a council of beings who magically bolstered and corrupted your body to make you into their chosen operative, a vicarious embodiment of their will.

entries.name: The Shadow Court
entries.summary: Magi of the Shadow Court conspire to shape local and regional politics with a blend of stealth, fighting prowess, and magical ability. Although those outside this eldritch society understand it to be a singular group, the Shadow Court is in fact composed of multiple clans that often wage clandestine wars on one another to obtain secrets and objects of power.

entries.name: The Shadowcat
entries.summary: Your patron is an otherworldly incarnation of fate that strides between planes; a living omen of ill luck and good fortune alike.

entries.name: The Sibyl
entries.summary: You have made a pact with the Sibyl, a divine being associated with prophecy, knowledge, and fate.

entries.name: The Sidereal Cabal
entries.summary: Magi in the Sidereal Cabal consult the stars to foresee the future and intercede at moments of particular import. Once, long ago, the cabal followed a philosophy of balance, believing that destiny and free will should be given equal weight.

entries.name: The Squared Circle
entries.summary: Pugilists who fight in the Squared Circle know you don’t have to knock an opponent senseless to get them to submit.

entries.name: The Storm Lord
entries.summary: You’ve made a pact with an ancient power known as the Storm Lord.

entries.name: The Sweet Science
entries.summary: Pugilists who practice the Sweet Science hit hard, fast, and often.

entries.name: The Sylvan Circle
entries.summary: Magi of the Sylvan Circle are drawn together by their reverence for the natural world. Members of this eldritch society become magi to protect sacred lands and creatures. Although this society is more informal than others, magi of the Sylvan Circle meet with one another regularly in small groups they call covens to discuss matters of local or regional concern and share information.

entries.name: The Undead
entries.summary: The Undead is an entity that resides in the dark corners of the multiverse. Your patron could be Acererak, Azalin, Lord Soth, Strahd, or some other ancient undead being. You may seek to gain knowledge from your patron’s countless lifetimes of experience, while it may see you as a piece of a centuries long plan.

entries.name: The Undead
entries.summary: You’ve made a pact with a deathless being, a creature that defies the cycle and life and death, forsaking its mortal shell so it might eternally pursue its unfathomable ambitions. For such beings, time and morality are fleeting things, the concerns of those for whom grains of sand still rush through life’s hourglass.

entries.name: The Undying Light
entries.summary: Your patron is not a specific entity, but the energy that radiates from the Positive Plane. Your pact allows you to experience the barest touch of the raw stuff of life that powers the multiverse.

entries.name: The Undying
entries.summary: Death holds no sway over your patron, who has unlocked the secrets of everlasting life, although such a prize- like all power- comes at a price.

entries.name: The Warrior Saint
entries.summary: You've made a pact with the Warrior-Saint, one of the great champions of the multiverse. This ancient being acts as an enforcer of the cosmic balance - law and chaos, good and evil.

entries.name: The Weaver of Lies
entries.summary: The speech of a god is the act of creation itself, but what happens when the gods lie? The small accumulated deceptions come together, forming a creature of webs and treachery, lies and deceit.

entries.name: The Wild Huntsman
entries.summary: You’ve made a pact with the Wild Huntsman, a dark incarnation of the predatory nature of man. Cursed with a bitter chill that can only be shaken by the blood of the prey and riding astride a steed whose eyes are cold as ice, the Wild Huntsman journeys between the planes seeking the greatest of challenges and the weakest of souls to harvest for its collection.

entries.name: Theurgy
entries.summary: A spellcaster that blends their arcane study with religious devotion.

entries.name: Thief
entries.summary: You hone your skills in the larcenous arts.

entries.name: Thief
entries.summary: Hunt for Treasure as a Classic Adventurer A mix of burglar, treasure hunter, and explorer, you are the epitome of an adventurer. In addition to improving your agility and stealth, you gain abilities useful for delving into ruins and getting maximum benefit from the magic items you find there.

entries.name: Thug
entries.summary: You reinforce verbal threats with acts of violence.

entries.name: Time Domain
entries.summary: Most spellcasters and sages agree that significant alterations to time are undesirable, but they disagree strongly on what constitutes a significant alteration.

entries.name: Timekeeper
entries.summary: A timekeeper uses seconds and minutes not as a way to measure life but as the key to great and mysterious power.

entries.name: Timeless Monumental
entries.summary: The influence of the Eternal Citadel grants you power and longevity to fight the forces of destruction for all eternity.

entries.name: Transcended
entries.summary: A Transcended Psion is most often one that has found their path to psionic powers through a mental epiphany, realizing the place of their mind within the multiverse and how it ties to everything else, seeing the keys and levers to the world laid out before them in their mind’s eye.

entries.name: Trapsmith
entries.summary: Trapsmiths are masters at setting and disarming traps of all types.

entries.name: Trickery Domain
entries.summary: Gods of trickery are mischief-makers and instigators who stand as a constant challenge to the accepted order among both gods and mortals.

entries.name: Trickery Domain
entries.summary: Make Mischief and Challenge Authority The Trickery Domain offers magic of deception, illusion, and stealth. Clerics who wield this magic are a disruptive force in the world, puncturing pride, mocking tyrants, freeing captives, and flouting hollow traditions.

entries.name: Twilight Domain
entries.summary: The twilit transition from light into darkness often brings calm and even joy, as the day’s labors end and the hours of rest begin. The darkness can also bring terrors, but the gods of twilight guard against the horrors of the night.

entries.name: Twilight Domain
entries.summary: The Twilight Domain governs the transition and blending of light into darkness.

entries.name: Undertaker
entries.summary: In a cemetery, a woman provides a service for a family grieving their lost one. She had spent the evening before prepping the corpse and making everything presentable for the wake. Her services were appreciated and she accepted her thanks, but her real joy would happen after everyone left.

entries.name: Unity Domain
entries.summary: A sense of oneness shines at the heart of healthy communities, whether bound together by friendship, blood, faith, or some other uniting force. The gods of unity deepen such bonds and delight in their strength.

entries.name: Unleashed
entries.summary: An Unleashed Psion’s power is most often an innate force they struggle to understand or control, a reflection of their state of mind and mood projected onto the world around them, often to devastating results.

entries.name: Vampiric Bloodline
entries.summary: Your innate magic stems from the mingling of your bloodline with the blood of a vampire.

entries.name: Vaquero
entries.summary: Vaqueros are born and raised in the life of the commonfolk, tending to ranches and animals. Because of this, they are experts at fighting on mounts. Vaqueros are speedy combatants that are hard to pin down, as well as experts at travel and exploration. This makes them naturally inclined to adventure.

entries.name: Virtuoso
entries.summary: Virtuosos don’t see guns as just a mere tool of destruction, they see them as an art form that they wish to master. Those who chose to train as virtuosos collect and train with as many guns as possible in to become more versatile and powerful shooters whose skill and showmanship is unrivaled.

entries.name: Void Speaker
entries.summary: You learn to properly invoke the words and glyphs to empower your magic and to tap the vast potential of the void.

entries.name: Wandering Mind
entries.summary: A Wandering Mind is among the more mysterious incarnates of psions, these are individuals that just aren’t quite rooted in the same reality everyone else is... they find it more pliable and slippery, and prone to jumping right through it on occasion.

entries.name: War Domain
entries.summary: The gods of war watch over warriors and reward them for their great deeds.

entries.name: War Domain
entries.summary: The gods of war watch over warriors and reward them for their great deeds.

entries.name: War Domain
entries.summary: Inspire Valor and Smite Foes War has many manifestations. It can make heroes of ordinary people. It can be desperate and horrific, with acts of cruelty and cowardice eclipsing instances of excellence and courage.

entries.name: War Magic
entries.summary: War mages act fast in battle, using their spells to seize tactical control of a situation.

entries.name: Warrior of Mercy
entries.summary: Manipulate Forces of Life and Death Warriors of Mercy manipulate the life force of others. These Monks are wandering physicians, but they bring a swift end to their enemies. They often wear masks, presenting themselves as faceless bringers of life and death.

entries.name: Warrior of Shadow
entries.summary: Harness Shadow Power for Stealth and Subterfuge Warriors of Shadow practice stealth and subterfuge, harnessing the power of the Shadowfell. They are at home in darkness, able to draw gloom around themselves to hide, leap from shadow to shadow, and take on a wraithlike form.

entries.name: Warrior of the Elements
entries.summary: Wield Strikes and Bursts of Elemental Power Warriors of the Elements tap into the power of the Elemental Planes. Harnessing their supernatural focus, these Monks momentarily tame the energy of the Elemental Chaos to empower themselves in and out of battle.

entries.name: Warrior of the Open Hand
entries.summary: Master Unarmed Combat Techniques Warriors of the Open Hand are masters of unarmed combat. They learn techniques to push and trip their opponents and manipulate their own energy to protect themselves from harm.

entries.name: Warsoul
entries.summary: A rituals can expose a warrior to the raw power of Shavarath. Most die in the process, but those with enough will and enough luck may gain their own warsoul.

entries.name: Wasteland Wanderer
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: Some worlds thrive, with large swathes of the land covered with flora and fauna that can be both beautiful and dangerous while other lands, or other worlds, become desolate wastelands through cataclysmic occurrences either natural or manufactured.

entries.name: Way of Atonement
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: Monks of the Way of Atonement seek absolve themselves for their past transgressions, sins, and current indiscretions by giving up their possessions and atoning through peaceful and selfless service.

entries.name: Way of Empathy
entries.publication: Xanathar’s Lost Notes to Everything Else
entries.summary: Monks of the Way of Empathy follow the tradition instilled with compassion for all living beings.

entries.name: Way of Mercy
entries.summary: Monks of the Way of Mercy learn to manipulate the life force of others to bring aid to those in need. They are wandering physicians to the poor and hurt. However, to those beyond their help, they bring a swift end as an act of mercy.

entries.name: Way of Mercy
entries.summary: You learned manipulate the life force of others to bring aid to those in need.

entries.name: Way of Shadow
entries.summary: Monks of the Way of Shadow follow a tradition that values stealth and subterfuge.

entries.name: Way of the Ascendant Dragon
entries.summary: The dragon god Bahamut is known to travel the Material Plane in the guise of a young monk, and legend says that he founded the first monastery of the Way of the Ascendant Dragon in this guise.

entries.name: Way of the Ascendant Dragon
entries.publication: Unearthed Arcana: Wonders of the Multiverse
entries.summary: Monks who follow the Way of the Ascendant Dragon revere the power and grandeur of dragons. They alter their own ki to resonate with draconic might, channeling it to augment their prowess in battle, soar through the air, and to bolster their allies.

entries.name: Way of the Astral Self
entries.summary: A monk who follows the Way of the Astral Self believes their body is an illusion. They see their ki as a representation of their true form, an astral self. This astral self has the capacity to be a force of order or disorder, with some monasteries training students to use their power to protect the weak and other instructing aspirants in how to manifest their true selves in service to the mighty.

entries.name: Way of the Astral Self
entries.summary: Monks of the Way of the Astral Self have an internal struggle with their ki.

entries.name: Way of the Black Star
entries.summary: The night sky has offered peace and solace in times of turmoil, exposing the insignificance of those who walk upon the earth, yet you do not call out for peace.

entries.name: Way of the Bloodied Fist
entries.summary: Monks of the Way of the Bloodied Fist follow a tradition that teaches them to control their own life force, as well as the life force of their foes. By focusing their ki, they exert control over blood - a powerful tool that is not to be underestimated.

entries.name: Way of the Cobalt Soul
entries.summary: Driven by the pursuit of knowledge and their worship of the Knowing Mistress, the monastery of the Cobalt Soul (known as the library of the Cobalt Reserve) stands as one of the most well-respected and most heavily guarded repository of tomes, history, and information across Exandria.

entries.name: Way of the Desert Wind
entries.summary: Monks who follow the Way of the Desert Wind draw their ki energy from the scorching winds of the most barren areas in Calimshan and other lands. Although you feel most at home in arid regions, you can summon this vast power wherever you are.

entries.name: Way of the Dream Walker
entries.summary: A monk following this tradition is either extremely troubled or extremely untroubled, with few in between.

entries.name: Way of the Drunken Master
entries.summary: Confounds foes through a martial arts tradition inspired by the swaying of a drunkard

entries.name: Way of the Eternal Spirit
entries.summary: Monks of the Way of the Eternal Spirit learn to channel the energy of the positive plane, using the powers that it grants to defend their allies and come to the aid of those that need it most.

entries.name: Way of the Four Elements (Remastered)
entries.publication: Reddit: Way of the Four Elements (Remastered)
entries.summary: You follow a monastic tradition that teaches you to harness the elements.

entries.name: Way of the Four Elements
entries.summary: You follow a monastic tradition that teaches you to harness the elements.

entries.name: Way of the Howling Gale
entries.summary: Hidden within the clouds atop mountain peaks are secret monasteries, who practice the bending of Elemental Air to their will.

entries.name: Way of the Immortal Flame
entries.summary: Monks everywhere study and train to bring discipline and order to their lives, and enlighten their minds.

entries.name: Way of the Iron Embrace
entries.summary: Monks of the Way of the Iron Embrace are masters of grapples, throws, and pins.

entries.name: Way of the Kensei
entries.summary: Channels ki through a set of mastered weapons

entries.name: Way of the Long Death
entries.summary: Monks of the Way of the Long Death are obsessed with the meaning and mechanics of dying.

entries.name: Way of the Noble Serpent
entries.summary: By lineage or accident of fate, spiritual enlightenment or inner turmoil, you’ve taken your first steps down the path of a servant of the Serpent Empress.

entries.name: Way of the Open Hand
entries.summary: The ultimate masters of martial arts combat, whether armed or unarmed.

entries.name: Way of the Shield
entries.summary: Some monasteries teach a specialized form of combat that is very different from traditional monk fighting techniques. This style is known as the Way of the Shield, and it emphasizes the shield as a living extension of the warrior.

entries.name: Way of the Soul Knife
entries.summary: Monks of the Way of the Soul Knife are monks who have learned to harnass and focus their ki, using their inner will and focus to control psionic powers - primarily into a blade of pure Psionic power: a Soul Knife.

entries.name: Way of the Sun Soul
entries.summary: Monks of the Way of the Sun Soul learn to channel their own life energy into searing bolts of light.

entries.name: Way of the Sun Soul
entries.summary: Transforms ki into bursts of fire and searing bolts of light

entries.name: Way of the Void
entries.publication: All the Lights in the Sky are Stars
entries.summary: Monks that follow the traditions of the Way of the Void look to the spaces between the stars for inspiration in their techniques. Their training emphasizes emptiness of mind and body, and monks of this tradition spend long hours in fasting and meditation.

entries.name: Way of Tranquility
entries.summary: Monks of the Way of Tranquility see violence as a last resort.

entries.name: Wayfarer
entries.summary: A master of helping their charges navigate dangerous passages and interactions with subterranean cultures.

entries.name: Wayfinder
entries.summary: A ranger who chooses the Wayfinder archetype is a master guide, safely leading others through dangerous wilderness regions. Wayfinders are more likely than other rangers to sell their services for coin, being especially prized by merchants seeking a secure path across hostile terrain, and by explorers wishing to investigate the unknown.

entries.name: Whiskey Fist
entries.summary: Pugilists in the Whiskey Fist fight club are the bane of tavern owners throughout the land.

entries.name: Whisper
entries.summary: You’ve dedicated your life to the arts of deception, disappearing, and illusion.

entries.name: Wild Magic Sorcery
entries.summary: Unleash Chaotic Magic Your innate magic stems from the forces of chaos that underlie the order of creation. You or an ancestor might have endured exposure to raw magic, perhaps through a planar portal leading to Limbo or the Elemental Planes.

entries.name: Wild Magic
entries.summary: Your innate magic comes from the wild forces of chaos that underlie the order of creation.

entries.name: Winter Domain
entries.summary: Good-aligned clerics appeal to winter deities such as Boreas to spare their people the worst of bitter cold, storms that last for days, and other calamities caused by weather.

entries.name: Zeal Domain
entries.summary: The zeal domain is granted to those who follow the teachings of the God-Pharaoh Hazoret.

entries.name: Breastplate
entries.summary: This armor consists of a fitted metal chest piece worn with supple leather. Although it leaves the legs and arms relatively unprotected, this armor provides good protection for the wearer’s vital organs while leaving the wearer relatively unencumbered.

value.name: Breastplate
value.description: Armor class: 14 + Dex modifier (max 2). This armor consists of a fitted metal chest piece worn with supple leather. Although it leaves the legs and arms relatively unprotected, this armor provides good protection for the wearer’s vital organs while leaving the wearer relatively unencumbered.

entries.name: Chain Mail
entries.summary: Made of interlocking metal rings, chain mail includes a layer of quilted fabric worn underneath the mail to prevent chafing and to cushion the impact of blows. The suit includes gauntlets.

entries.summary: Made of interlocking metal rings, a chain shirt is worn between layers of clothing or leather. This armor offers modest protection to the wearer’s upper body and allows the sound of the rings rubbing against one another to be muffled by outer layers.

entries.name: Half Plate
entries.summary: Half plate consists of shaped metal plates that cover most of the wearer’s body. It does not include leg protection beyond simple greaves that are attached with leather straps.

entries.name: Hide
entries.summary: This crude armor consists of thick furs and pelts. It is commonly worn by barbarian tribes, evil humanoids, and other folk who lack access to the tools and materials needed to create better armor.

entries.name: Leather

entries.name: Baldur’s Gate Feature: Criminal Connections
entries.summary: In Baldur’s Gate, crime is just another business. As a result, you can arrange a meeting with a low ranking operative of nearly any business, patriar family, crew, government institution, or—certainly— the Guild. This operative will hear you out and, at their discretion take your information on request up their chain of command. These meetings almost always occur in shady venues.

entries.name: Baldur’s Gate Feature: Immigrant Experience
entries.summary: Even after your short time in Baldur’s Gate, you’ve learned the city holds more walls and gates that those the Watch and Flaming Fist patrols. You are known within the city’s immigrant communities. Should you ever need to learn about a foreign land, people, tradition, or history, you know where to find someone with first-hand experience—likely somewhere in the Outer City.

entries.name: Baldur’s Gate Feature: Loyalty Test
entries.summary: You’ve had enough dealings with crooked soldiers that you can spot the behaviors common to corrupt guards and military officers a mile away. While awareness of such corruption doesn’t equate to evidence of it, and your sense certainly isn’t foolproof, your instinct proves a useful starting point when determining who might take a bribe, who might turn a blind eye to a crime, or who might have criminal connections.

entries.name: Baldur’s Gate Feature: Religious Community
entries.summary: You’re tightly connected with the religious community of Baldur’s Gate. You know if a deity has a following in the city and any places that faith openly congregates and the neighborhoods those faithful typically inhabit. While this isn’t remarkable for most of the city’s larger faiths, keeping track of the hundreds of religions newcomers bring with them is no mean feat.

entries.name: Baldur’s Gate Feature: Smuggler’s Sense
entries.summary: You’re familiar with the docks of Baldur’s Gate, the movement of inspectors and tax collectors, the way cargo and coin flows. As a result, it’s easy for you to hustle a load of cargo ashore or see such a cargo onto a cooperative ship without attracting suspicion or taxation. You also know the movements of the Gray Wavers—the Flaming Fist harbor guards—and have a sense of to operate the city’s mechanized cranes.

entries.name: Baldur’s Gate Feature: Social Vengeance
entries.summary: You’ve lived your entire life in the Lower or Outer City of Baldur’s Gate. You grew up seeing arrogant patriars flaunt their wealth while your hardworking neighbors struggled. As a result, you know how eager commoners in Baldur’s Gate are to see any patriar get what they deserve.

entries.name: Baldur’s Gate Feature: The Real City
entries.summary: You know the Baldur’s Gate most Baldurians ignore, the dog-eat-dog world of the homeless and unfortunate. You know where to go inside the Lower City, and Outer City for anonymity. In these slums and alley camps, you can get a damp bed and a bad meal, but also a degree of privacy and no questions asked. Living here isn’t comfortable, but it’s unlikely anyone will find you—and you can stay as long as you want.
